Winter Highlights:

Ski, sled, or simply soak in the winter beauty. Book your unforgettable Crested Butte getaway at Whetstone Vista today!

 Guest access

description_text:
Private 15-acre luxury retreat with stunning mountain views, a hot tub, and space for large groups. Perfect for family gatherings, group getaways, and unforgettable Colorado experiences.

 The space 
Escape to this spacious 4,000 sq ft mountain retreat on 15 private acres in Crested Butte, perfect for families and groups seeking breathtaking views, peaceful surroundings, and year-round adventure. Whether you're soaking in the hot tub as snow falls over the Gunnison Valley or enjoying a quiet morning coffee on the deck, this home offers a true Colorado mountain experience.

The home features an open-concept living, kitchen, and dining area designed for gathering and relaxing together. The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped with high-end appliances, granite countertops, and seating for 6 at the island, while the dining table comfortably seats 8 with sweeping valley views. The living room offers a large gas fireplace, a 66-inch TV, and plenty of space to unwind after a day of exploring.

With 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and a spacious den, the home comfortably accommodates large groups. Two bedrooms are located on the main floor, including a primary suite with a king bed, private bathroom, and jacuzzi tub, as well as an additional king bedroom. 

Upstairs, you'll find another primary suite with a king bed and private bath, plus a fourth bedroom with a queen bed and two twin beds. The upstairs den provides flexible sleeping arrangements with two sleeper sofas and trundle beds, making it a great space for kids or additional guests.

Step outside to take in the expansive mountain views from the large deck, complete with seating, a gas grill, and an 8-person hot tub overlooking the valley. The 15-acre property offers privacy and direct access to the surrounding natural beauty, with the Gunnison National Forest just nearby for hiking, skiing, and endless outdoor adventures.

Additional amenities include high-speed Wi-Fi, a laundry room, a mudroom, and ample parking for multiple vehicles, trailers, or recreational gear.
The home is located approximately 15 minutes from town and 20 minutes from the ski slopes, offering a perfect balance of seclusion and convenience.


Please note: During the winter months, AWD or 4WD vehicles are required to access the property due to mountain road conditions.  

Also, we do not recommend relying on services like Uber to get to and from the airport. There are few drivers in the valley and we have found the service to be somewhat unreliable.

Remodeled 4BD, 3BA dog friendly home in Meridian Lake residential neighborhood with stunning views.

 The space 
This lovely single family home offers amazing views, privacy and easy access to trails out Washington Gulch road.  The neighborhood is located between the towns of Crested Butte and Mt Crested Butte, so you'll have easy access to both areas. 
Upon entering the updated home, you'll find 3 bedrooms on the ground floor.  Two of these bedrooms on the ground floor, one with a king bed and one with two twins, share a full bath.  The third bedroom has a queen bed and ensuite full bath.  Access to the garage and a large laundry room complete the ground floor spaces.  Upstairs, you'll find the primary bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, a large, well appointed kitchen with everything your group will need to stay nourished during your stay.   The dining room has plenty of seating for family dinners and the inviting  living room has comfortable seating and a large TV (bring your favorite streaming app passwords with you).  An oversized deck off of the kitchen has seating for outside dining and a gas grill.  Windows throughout this property truly highlight the grandeur of the surrounding peaks, namely, Mt Crested Butte.  Games have been provided to keep all entertained while indoors.  

All of our kitchens are fully stocked with pots, pans, cookware and utensils.  While most properties have salt, pepper, and basic cooking pantry items, we do not guarantee these will be available upon arrival.

The Meridian Lake subdivision is located between the towns of Mt. Crested Butte and Crested Butte.  Crested Butte Mountain Resort, where you can ski or ride the famous steeps we are known for, is only 5 minutes away while the historic mining town of Crested Butte is about a 7 minute drive.  

NO SMOKING IS ALLOWED anywhere on the premises. Any evidence of smoke will incur fees.

Colvin Ranch House is a luxury custom home on 35 acres, which is part of Whetstone Mountain Ranch. WMR is a private 300-acre ranch located 2 miles from Crested Butte. The ranch offers hiking trails, 5 lakes and private access to the Slate River with world class fishing. The largest lake has a campfire area complete with picnic tables and grill. Hike or bike into town on the Deli Trail or Flag the bus at the new Bus Stop at Riverbend. The master suite has an adjacent office/sitting/TV area and a a deck with views of the mountains. Downstairs has 3 bedrooms all w/ TVs; 2 junior masters (one with sitting area) with King beds and en suite baths with showers. The 3rd bedroom has a Queen bed with a bath across the hall with a bath/shower combo. All 3 bedrooms have large windows, exterior doors leading to a private covered patio surrounded by ponds and the sound of running streams in the summer. The 5th sleeping area is a bunkroom located off the Den/Media room with 2 Queens and 2 Twin XL beds. The 5th full bath that services the bunkroom is conveniently located off the Den/Media area. All bedrooms have plenty of closet/storage space and 3 laundry spaces for your use.

The kitchen is outfitted with a Wolfe 6 burner/griddle stove, oven, microwave, warming drawer, Sub Zero refrigerator/freezer and 2 dishwashers. The main dining area seats 8, kitchen nook seats 6 and the kitchen bar seats 5. On the back deck is a propane grill and hot tub that straddles a stream and has a picture framed view of Mt. CB. The main living area and the back deck have a King Systems audio system for your listening enjoyment. Direct TV and wireless internet in all areas of the home. The den/media room is equipped with a 65'' TV, wet bar and wine refrigerator. A great place to watch movies, play games, work puzzles or just hang out. Streams run around the main house with closed in bridges connecting the 3 structures.

The guest efficiency apartment is 700 Sq Ft located above "The Barn," which only stables motorized horsepower. You will find a King bed, sitting/TV area, bath with shower and a kitchen with a gas stove, mini refrigerator, breakfast bar, kitchen table and a balcony with up valley views.

description_text:
Nestled in the heart of the Quartz Creek Valley of the western slopes of the Rocky Mountains, Sage Mountain Retreats and Rentals is waiting to provide for your needs any season of the year. From the refreshing quietness of beautiful views of the valley to the rugged adventures waiting to be discovered by any outdoor enthusiast Sage Mountain Retreat and Rentals will provide a cozy and clean cabin to relax and recharge in. We are located in hunting GMU 55 and across the street from 551.

 The space 
Ursa Major is a log cabin about 600 sqft in size. It has a carpeted loft with railings and a gate that latches. There is a very sturdy ladder to access the loft. If you have small children that you don’t want climbing the ladder, there is not currently a deterrent to keep them from climbing. Children love to play in the loft. Please watch your children and be sure to close the gate at the top for their safety. It is safest to ascend and descend the ladder while facing it. 

There is a ditch that gets “turned on” for about 8 weeks of the summer. It is about 30 yards from the cabin. Please keep an eye on your children as it can be several feet deep in some places.

 Guest access 
Guests can park beside the cabin on the east side, on the West side of the cabin between the aspen tree and the hydrant, or if pulling a trailer you can park in the grass by the split rail fence on the south side of the cabin. Please do not park directly in front of the cabin except for loading and unloading.


Guests are welcome to walk around and enjoy the lower portion of the property. The hillsides are currently off limits. If you wish to hike up the hill, please reach out to Art for some instructions. Guests are not allowed to walk through the property to get to public land and are not allowed to hunt or shoot on the property.

description_text:
Enjoy modern mountain living while you escape with friends or family. Located 10-min drive from the town of CB, close to hiking, biking,  fly-fishing and all of your favorite outdoor activities. If you are looking for a more relaxed trip, simply enjoy the beautiful mountain views or stargazing.  Dining out in CB offers a wide variety of options,  but the chef's kitchen is well appointed for those sticking close to home to catch  sunset from the patio. CB will make your vacation dreams come true!

 The space 
Open concept main floor living with gourmet kitchen, table seating for up to 8, and  large living room to gather. In total you will enjoy more than 2,000 sq ft to spread out and relax.  The main floor also includes a half bath and laundry room. Upstairs, guests will find the primary suite with walk in closet and 2 additional bedrooms. All bedrooms have a luxurious king bed for sleeping bliss. Also upstairs is a desk for those who may need to fit in a little work while getting away.

Brand new hot tub on the patio is incredible for stargazing or even to take in the amazing sunset views!!!

Enjoy mountain biking or a hike right out the front door by visiting Whetstone Vista Trailhead, easily accessible from the house.  For the more adventurous folks, some of the areas best mountain biking can be ridden directly from the front door. Check out Teocalli Ridge, or even Deer Creek for a XC ride.

Cycle into town to grab a bite to eat or wander through the Sunday Farmer's Market. 

Crested Butte National Historic District is located along Elk Ave, and will not disappoint.  Here you will find excellent dining, drinks and boutiques to suit your needs. 

If you prefer to spend your time near the water, check out one of our local outfitters for fly-fishing along the Slate River or paddle boarding on Lake Irwin.

 Guest access 
Guests will have access to the entire townhome and heated two car garage.  A sliding door leads to a large patio with seating area to enjoy the private hot tub and amazing views.

description_text:
Welcome to the Oh-Be-Joyful Ranch!  A 7-acre ranch just 5 minutes from downtown Crested Butte and 10 min from world-class Crested Butte skiing.

A unique opportunity to stay in a historic cabin that's been recently rehabbed, with 360 views of the mountains and wildflower-filled valley. If you're interested in immersing in nature, this is your place. Take in the mountains from the hot tub, sit under the amazing stars around the fire pit or gather around the  stone fireplace after a day of skiing.

 The space 
This cozy space is an original cabin that's had multiple additions/upgrades, but still retains the original hearth and stone fireplace, woodwork, and character.

The cabin's upgrades include a sweeping 2-story entry and dining room, an upgraded fully-stocked kitchen with an open floor plan, and an upper-level loft that can be used as a workspace, for hanging out or as a 3rd bedroom (it has a full-sized bed, but note the loft must be accessed through the master bedroom).

There are three full bedrooms: one on the lower level with a queen bed and original log walls, a master suite on the upper level (with another queen bed and its own sitting area), and the upstairs loft bedroom. We have several inflatable mattresses with extra pillows and blankets if needed. There is a full bath on each level plus a laundry room on the lower level.

The cabin is full of original woodwork and features, Native American rugs, textiles, artwork and retro "ranch" found items.

There are new 100% cotton towels, sheets, cozy blankets and down comforters throughout. We also provide full-sized natural shampoo, conditioner and soaps in the bathrooms. 

We've really taken care to fully stock the kitchen with all the pots, pans, bowls and cooking implements you'll need to create family meals, as well as serving bowls/platters/pitchers for memorable festive dinners, including holidays. There is coffee, salt/pepper, spices and other cooking basics provided.

Spend your time outdoors, where you'll find a sweet fenced backyard with the new 6-person hot tub, or the large brand new side patio with outdoor sitting area, chiminea  and gas grill. When not outdoors, cook up a feast in the fully-equipped kitchen, cozy up by the large original stone fireplace, play one of the many board games provided or watch a movie on the HD TV with Amazon Firestick.

We've recently purchased this ranch as our personal passion project and are in the process of continuing to modernize the cabin and upgrade the outdoor spaces. Enjoy this authentic cabin experience and return again in the future to check out what’s to come!

 Guest access 
Guests have access to the entire cabin, as well as the backyard, hot tub, large side patio, grill, seating area and chiminea.

Note: There are multiple outbuildings (like the old barn) which have yet to be rehabbed, so we appreciate folks enjoying the cabin on the Northern side of the ranch and steering clear of the other outbuildings/land, which are still in-progress and not yet safe for guests. There is an airstream on the far South side of the ranch this is occasionally used by the property manager. The airstream is several acres away from the cabin and on the other side of trees/the barn - you will have 100% privacy at the cabin, both indoors & out.

Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space, featuring 2 gas fireplaces and outdoor Solo stove. One block from Nordic ski & Mt biking trails, walking distance to Red Mountain Park w/free parking and free buses to downtown CB, Mt. CB and Gunnison. The park:outdoor skating pond, hockey rink, soccer field,playground and tennis courts.  Enjoy restaurants, coffee shop, a brewery in CB south or all Crested Butte and the mountain have to offer. The mountains are snow capped & more on the way!

 The space 
The backyard/deck side of the home has gorgeous unobstructed views up valley to Mt CB and the Elk Mt range. This home is 9 min to downtown Crested Butte and 15 min to the Mt. Crested Butte ski area. 

The kitchen is fully stocked, has a dining table to seat 8 and 4 bar stools. The open design of the kitchen, dining and living room allow for activity in a larger space. The living room also has a table seating 6 for game playing or puzzles. The main floor also includes the primary bedroom with a king bed and full bath with separate shower and tub; a den/library with a window seat and queen sleeper sofa;  a half bath; laundry room with washer and dryer; and doors to the back deck, garage and front entrance. 

The second floor has a loft/lounge area with a comfortable L-shaped couch, a full bathroom with double sinks, and 3 bedrooms: 1 queen bedroom; 1 king bedroom and 1 bedroom with a two twin beds. All bedrooms have large closets and ample space for your belongings.

One side of the heated garage is available for parking and storing skis/boots. The driveway can also be used for 2 cars however if there is a snowfall of more than 6 inches, the cars will need to be moved for the plowing service. There is no street parking allowed in Crested Butte South.

 The space

description_text:
Come enjoy this cozy newly built studio apartment with easy access to the RTA bus stop, the quaint Camp 4 coffee shop, Zuni West Brewery, Tully's Bar and Grill, and the Wooden Spoon. Come experience the outdoor paradise here in the upper Gunnison Valley and end your day in the quiet of CBSouth.  
Only 30 min. from the Gunnison airport;  a 6 min. walk to the RTA bus stop; a 12 min. drive to downtown Crested Butte for shopping; and a 20 minute drive to the Crested Butte Mountain Resort.

 The space 
The stylish entryway is decked out with ski holders and plenty of hooks for coats, hats, gloves, purses etc. The studio has a comfortable queen sized murphy bed that operates with ease. It offers a brand new full kitchen and an in-unit laundry space. Dine in front of big windows that let in beautiful natural light. A desk is nestled in a nook and there is couch that faces the smart TV.

 Guest access 
Guests have access to the entire studio apartment, the furnished balcony off the back of the apartment and the back yard. There is one dedicated “Gillaspey Getaway” parking space.

Note: The studio is located above a garage and requires stairs to access.

 Other things to note 
Walkable CB South amenities:
Tully’s bar & grill, Camp 4 Coffee, Zuni West Brewery, Wooden Spoon, Mail Dropbox, Red Mountain Liquor store, RTA bus stop

THE RTA BUS STOP is located at 355 Teocalli Rd, Crested Butte, CO 81224. It is a 2 minute drive or a 6 minute walk. 
*WALK: Turn left out of the driveway on Gillaspey Ave and walk just past Red Mountain Liquors.  As the road turns towards the right, turn left into the large driveway where there is a path with a wooden fence. It has a green and white pedestrian sign on it. The path will take you to Teocalli Rd where you will take a right. Then, take your first right and you will see tennis courts, a small building with the bus schedule on it and a parking area.
*DRIVE: Put the above address in your GPS.
***The schedule can be found on the Gunnison Valley RTA website.

Crested Butte amenities:
Clark’s Market & Mountain Earth Organic Grocer, The Center, RTA bus stop, shipping and banking, the Majestic movie theater, the Nordic Center (rentals/lots of groomed trails), fabulous shopping and restaurants

Nearby activities: Free CB South nordic trails (4 blocks), Cement Creek hiking and biking trails (1 mile), Wuanita’s Hot Springs (east of Gunnison), Ice Skating Rink (Crested Butte)

Gunnison amenities:
Airport, Safeway & City Market, shipping and banks, Gunnison Valley Health hospital

PETS: Pets are NOT allowed. If there is evidence of a pet, you will be charged a $250 fine plus additional fees for odor removal and all deep cleaning associated with removing evidence of a pet for the next guests.

description_text:
Welcome to 120 Teocalli Unit 2– a charming, family-friendly townhome nestled in the heart of Crested Butte South! This prime location offers easy access to everything you need for a perfect mountain getaway, whether you're visiting in winter or summer. Just a short walk from the free RTA bus, local restaurants, a coffee shop, liquor store, and more, this home is an ideal base for your Crested Butte adventure.

 The space 
This spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom townhome comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests. The master suite features a king-size bed and two twin bunk beds, plus an en-suite bathroom—perfect for families traveling with kids. Downstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms, each with a queen bed and private en-suite bathroom, ensuring comfort and privacy for all guests.

Crested Butte South is a peaceful and scenic community, where kids can safely play outside and soak in the beauty of the surrounding nature. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the easy access to Cement Creek, just a short drive away, offering excellent hiking, biking, and fishing opportunities. Plus, downtown Crested Butte is only 10-15 minutes away, making it easy to explore all that this vibrant mountain town has to offer.

Sleeping Arrangements:
Master Bedroom (Upper Level): 1 King Bed + 2 Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 6) (En-Suite)
Bedroom 2 (Lower Level): 1 Queen Bed (En-Suite)
Bedroom 3 (Lower Level): 1 Queen Bed (En-Suite)

Parking:
1 garage parking space
2 additional spaces behind the garage (Total: 3 vehicles)

Whether you're here for world-class skiing, scenic summer trails, or a relaxing retreat in the mountains, 120 Teocalli is the perfect home base for your next Crested Butte getaway!

Book through Peak Property Management & Sales and receive special discounts for ski and snowboard rentals through Christy Sports!

We are the property management company for this vacation rental.

description_text:
Welcome to your private alpine escape in the heart of one of Crested Butte’s most desirable neighborhoods. This brand-new luxury home blends modern elegance with rustic charm, offering an unparalleled mountain experience just minutes from world-class skiing, mountain biking, scenic trails, and vibrant town life. 

Perched at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this three-story home boasts jaw-dropping views from every window and two full-length decks perfect for sunrise coffee or sunset cocktails.

 The space 
Inside, radiant floor heating warms every room—including the garage and mudroom—while top-of-the-line, low-VOC materials and organic linens create a health-conscious, low-allergen sanctuary. 

With four spacious bedrooms (2 rooms with California Kings, 1 Queen room,  and one bunk room with 2 twin-over-full beds), the home comfortably accommodates large families. There are blackout shades in every room, and all brand-new, spine-aligning mattresses to ensure restful sleep.

There are three full baths (1 on the first garage floor and 2 on the middle/bedroom floor).  There is also a 1/2 bath on top floor.  **Please note: there are no ensuite/attached bathrooms to the bedrooms, ie no master**. 

The open-concept top floor is a showstopper, featuring a gourmet chef’s kitchen with a 48" high-end range, espresso machine, and walk-in pantry. The dining table seats 8 with additional seating at the oversized island, and the adjacent living room—with gas fireplace and smart TV—is made for après-ski gatherings.

Remote workers will love the dedicated office with panoramic views and a printer/scanner. The middle floor living space has another smart TV, children’s toys, puzzles, and high-speed internet to keep everyone entertained.

Additional amenities include a 2-car garage with ski and bike storage, a bonus gear space, two washer/dryers, whole-house water filtration, and a reverse osmosis drinking water system.

Enjoy exclusive access to a private, stocked lake just a 5-minute stroll away, and walk to Long Lake for exceptional fishing and hiking.  The ski mountain parking lot is 6-7 min drive. 

Experience the luxury, serenity, and natural beauty of Crested Butte—your unforgettable mountain getaway starts here.

 Guest access 
In addition to the house, guests will have access to the 2 car garage and the attached single-car garage for use as storage space for skiis, bikes, etc.  

Please note that there is  a 7-foot height limit to get into the garage. Please be aware if you have a bike or storage rack on top of your car.

 Other things to note 
As a part of a low allergen home, we do not under any circumstance allow pets.  This includes services animals unfortunately.  If you have a service animal, please do NOT rent this house.  Due to owners medical condition with severe allergies  we must adhere to this policy strictly.  

There are stairs throughout this 3 level home, and baby gates are not provided. There is no elevator.

As with most homes in the area, there is no A/C, but summer nights are refreshingly cool. There is ceiling fan on the top floor.

No large gathering/parties allowed.

description_text:
Your peaceful CB ski base, 9 min from town. The free RTA bus drops you slope-side: a 60-second drive to the stop, free all-day parking, a 15-20 min ride, and no expensive mountain parking. Come home to a private hot tub under starry skies, a fireplace and steam shower in the primary suite, and cozy radiant heat. Guests always tell us it's way roomier than expected: 3 levels, 2 living rooms, boot dryers and gear storage. Turn this slice of paradise into cherished memories that last a lifetime.

 The space 
The home features 3 levels with brand-new Berber carpet and new hardwood floors. As part of a duplex, your hosts live next door and are always happy to help you make the most of your stay.

ENTRY/MAIN FLOOR
• Slate mudroom
• Half bath
• Fully equipped kitchen/dining area with vaulted ceilings and brand-new Bosch dishwasher
• Living room with TV
• Balcony deck with outdoor seating to enjoy your morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or a meal with: 
~sweeping mountain views, 
~starry nights, 
~wildlife like deer, foxes, and birds galore.

DOWNSTAIRS
•Walkout basement to the hot tub and backyard
• Second living room with TV for dedicated kid space or movie nights with a wet bar for evening drinks
• Full bath with tub/shower
• Bedroom with queen bed and mountain views
• Laundry room with brand-new washer and dryer

BACK YARD
• Private hot tub for amazing sunsets or stargazing at the Milky Way, shooting stars & satellites wizzing by. 
• Solo Stove fireplace for cozy nights

• Hanging egg chair – perfect for relaxing or journaling while gazing at the mountains and wildlife.
• Lush, maintained grass - your bare feet will love it 😊 
• We have a tripod you can use to get amazing night sky shots with your phone camera.

UPSTAIRS
• Primary bedroom: handmade bespoke Carpe Diem Swedish king bed (so comfy!), gas fireplace, 
• Primary ensuite bath with: 
~steam shower 
~deep, clawfoot tub for pure relaxation.
• Bunk-bed room: queen-size lower bunk, full XL top bunk, and twin trundle bed; perfect for kids or groups of friends. A comfy rocker and dedicated workspace with ergonomic chair complete this cozy space.
• Full bath with shower, accessed from the hallway

ADDITIONAL BEDS
• We have a Pack n Play crib available,
• The second living room downstairs with blackout curtains is perfect for the air mattress.

GETTING AROUND/NEARBY 
• Mountain biking right out the door. Incredibly fun trails. 
- Hike, ride or drive to "the caves" right down Cement Creek Road (free parking).
• Free shuttle bus stop and local park are just a 1-minute drive or 6-minute walk away (free parking). Bus goes to Crested Butte & the Mountain or to Almont & Gunnison
• Park amenities include: playground, swings, tennis court, basketball court, pump track, half-pipe, baseball and soccer fields, ice rink, ice pond, and expansive nordic ski trails, kite-flying space.
• Fishing - Access to East River and Cement Creek
• Restaurants: Walking distance to Camp4Coffee, Zuni Brewing tap house & Tully's restaurant.

THE COMMUNITY
CB South is a small community just south of the town of Crested Butte/Mt. CB. We have local amenities like a restaurant, coffee shop, liquor store, general store, a full gym, salon, and the brand new Zuni West Brewery. We're also only 15 minutes from Almont with famous fishing & white water rafting. And Gunnison is 25 minutes south of us with a ton of activities like their white water park, rock climbing, mountain biking &  shopping (boutiques as well as Walmart & City Market).

NEED OXYGEN?
Our home sits at 8,600 ft and many activities take you well above 10,000 ft. That can make altitude sickness a real possibility — but we’ve got you covered. We offer a compact, portable oxygen concentrator (perfect for sleep or rest) for a small nightly fee. Please message us if you’re interested and we’ll tell you how to add it to your booking.

description_text:
Basecamp @ Willow Creek is your ultimate 40 acre, off-grid retreat, nestled on the banks of a serene beaver pond teeming with wild brook trout. This cozy, modern-rustic cabin features a queen bed on the main floor, four twin beds in the loft, and one bathroom. Powered by a propane generator, it offers all the essentials with a touch of rugged charm—barn wood finishes, brass accents, and a spacious covered porch perfect for soaking in nature’s beauty. 45 miles from Montrose, Gunnison & Lake City.

 The space 
For people who love the camping experience and appreciate a real bed at the end of the day.

Basecamp at Willow Creek is a rustic, off-grid Colorado cabin for slowing down, spending time outdoors, and enjoying a simpler mountain stay. Think thoughtfully outfitted mountain hut: cozy, adventurous, and hands-on.

Off-grid living is part of the experience here. Please read the power, water, road-access, and arrival details below to make sure Basecamp fits your getaway.

OFF-GRID: KNOW BEFORE YOU BOOK

Basecamp is a rustic, off-grid mountain cabin. Think comfortable mountain hut with a hands-on approach to cabin life. Please make sure the following arrangements suit everyone in your group.

POWER & GENERATOR
Electricity comes from a propane generator. Guests start and stop it themselves with a short demonstration. It powers the lights, heat and hot water heater. When it is off, the stove and refrigerator and cold water (toilet) still work. Hot water, lights, and furnace will not work without the generator. There is a propane firepit on the covered porch.

The generator is located on the east side of the cabin outside and is audible. It is not designed to run all the time. Only when you need it. 

WATER & BATHROOM
Water comes from a well on the adjoining property and is stored in a big tank under the deck. We provide 5 Gallons of bottled drinking water and recommend that you bring water with you as well. After the water sits in the tank, it is not good to drink. 

The bathroom has a flush toilet and modern shower. Hot water is provided by an on demand instant electric hot water heater that requires the generator to be running. The water pump is a 12 volt RV pump powered by a car battery and charged with a solar panel, you can hear it under the house when it runs but is not loud.  

GETTING HERE
The final stretch, depending on the direction of travel, includes approximately 12 - 20 miles of unpaved road. It is accessible with 2 wheel drive vehicles but the road is dusty and bumpy. Very low clearance vehicles are not recommended. 

There are 2 gates along the route. You will be given a detailed map and gate codes after booking. Please leave gates how you find them. Please follow our written directions and downloaded map; Google maps will NOT get you here. Plan to arrive well before sundown. We ask that you arrive by 5pm so that we can welcome you and show you the ropes. 

CELL SERVICE & WI-FI
Cell reception is very spotty. You may get one or two bars if you are standing in the right spot. Wi-Fi is not available. Download your directions  (and media) before leaving reliable service.

If you need help during your stay, contact us through text message. If we are unavailable, you will have a backup contact. We live nearby but are often out of cell service so we will answer your text when we get service.

Cell service at Basecamp is unreliable. There are pockets of reception along the access road and at our neighboring property, Rockin’ A. We’ll identify these locations during your arrival walkthrough and on your printed guest map.

In an emergency, call 911. If you cannot connect from the cabin, you may need to travel to a known reception area, if safe to do so. Immediate communication from the cabin cannot be guaranteed.

A helicopter landing area is located across the road. Its GPS coordinates, along with the cabin’s location and access information, will be provided in the printed emergency instructions. Give this information to the

description_text:
Single family home in a quiet residential neighborhood called Riverbend, 2 miles from the town of Crested Butte. Bike or walk the path to the town of CB.  New furniture and upgrades throughout & a one car garage for car or gear storage. Outdoor amenities include a hot tub, large patio with firepit and upper deck/grill area.

 The space 
Space to spread out, room to gather back together—this 4-bedroom Riverbend home sleeps 9 and is purpose-built for multiple families or multi-generational trips. Soak in the hot tub as mountain peaks blaze orange at sunset, then head inside to all-new furniture, mattresses, appliances, and linens throughout, so everything feels fresh from the moment you arrive.

Downstairs
Three guest bedrooms—a queen, a twin/twin, and a twin/twin plus trundle—share a spacious full bath with double vanity and a separate tub and shower, making it easy for a full house to get ready at once without the morning bottleneck.

Upstairs
This is where the magic happens: an open, light-filled living, dining, and kitchen area unfolds beneath sweeping mountain views, with a south-facing deck made for grilling and long afternoons outside. The fully stocked kitchen is ready for your best meals, whatever the occasion calls for. Just off the main space, the primary suite offers a quiet retreat of its own, with a king bed, smart TV, and a spa-like bath featuring a soaking tub and double vanity.

Outside
Step out to the west patio, where a built-in fire pit, hot tub, and cozy seating invite you to linger long after dinner, under Crested Butte's famously starry skies—the perfect way to close out any day here.

All of our kitchens are fully stocked with pots, pans, cookware and utensils. While most properties have salt, pepper, and basic cooking pantry items, we do not guarantee these will be available upon arrival. 
The minimum age for all persons in this property is 25 years, excepting children (of all ages) with their parent or legal guardian. Please note that we do count all children and infants in the headcount for the property.
No events or parties allowed. This property is located in a residential neighborhood so renters must be mindful of the neighbors. All vehicles, trailers, and campers must be parked in the driveway. NO ON STREET PARKING. 4 vehicles are allowed. No smoking, of any substance, is allowed in or on the premises. 
This property is not pet friendly.
 Please note that our company does have a separate rental policy that will be emailed to you immediately after booking and this will need to be signed by you.  If you wish to see it prior to booking, just send us an email.

 Guest access 
Check-in instructions including your keypad door code will be sent to you 3 days prior to your arrival at 4 PM MST.

description_text:
A break from the pricey bustle of downtown CB. Private, newly renovated apartment in CB South home with your own fenced yard for dogs and a fire pit. New floors, new kitchen, new windows, new beds. Park and walk/bike to the CB South bus stop and catch free buses to Crested Butte and the CBMR ski area. One bedroom has a king bed and the other has two twin beds. All new Casper mattresses. Walk to CB South's The Cabin, Camp 4 Coffee and Zuni West Brewery for live music and fun local atmosphere.

 The space 
In winter enjoy easy access to the Gunnison National Forest via county maintained Cement Creek Road for snowshoeing, groomed cross country skiing, fat-biking, snowmobiling, road hiking or out your front door an HOA maintained and lighted hockey rink, skating pond and nordic track.

In summer, it’s trails, trails and more trails for single track moto/non-motorized riding, hiking, wildflower/wildlife viewing are all just a 15-min walk or 5-min drive. East River access offering incredible catch-and-release fishing is a 10-min walk from the front door. Red Mountain Park is right across the street with a playground and open grass for disc, fetch or a picnic with all-time views.  Basketball and pickle ball courts too.

Free all-day bus service to the towns of Crested Butte and Mt. Crested Butte, Crested Butte Mountain Resort and Gunnison is right across the street, making car-free vacations a reality. The Town of Crested Butte is a 10-min drive away. Or, CB South's Zuni Street Brewing, Camp 4 Coffee, Tully’s Grill, The Cabin or the Wooden Spoon and Country Store are a short-stroll away, with local favorites for food and drink. Stop by Red Mountain Liquor on your way back if needing additional refreshments.

 Guest access 
The unit is on the side of the house  with they entry in the backyard.  Park on the right side of the house where the sign says 'Guest Parking'. Go through the fence and the door is on the left. 

The fenced backyard, two hybrid bikes and fire pit are all yours!

The perfect mountain getaway in a newly built town home just minutes from town, ski slopes, hiking and mountain biking! The house comes with a 2 car garage (heated!). Heated floors in the house, boot dryer/warmers, ping pong table. Shared access to pickle ball courts and a playground in the community.

 Other things to note 
Welcome to our Crested Butte getaway. This newly built townhome is minutes from town, the slopes, and all the hiking, biking, and fishing you could ask for. Built in the mountain modern style this home is sure to please with the clean lines, comfy beds, and even a ping pong table for the whole family to enjoy.Located less than 2 minutes from the town of Crested Butte, and under 10 minutes to the slopes makes this townhome the perfect place for enjoying the mountains by day and checking out town for dinner, drinks, and live music in the evening.

Step inside and kick off your hiking boots, skis, or bike & fishing gear, and get ready to relax. We like to use our garage/mud room as an extension of the home. There is plenty of room for all of your gear and even a boot dryer for those well used ski and wader boots. In the garage you can play a game of ping pong while catching the game on the big screen.

Inside on the first floor you will find the master bedroom with King bed and en-suite bath which gives it great separation from the upstairs living space. Upstairs you come into the great room with vaulted ceilings and views of Mt. Crested Butte through the floor to ceiling picture window that covers the kitchen in natural light. The kitchen is fully equipped and the large quartz countertops mean there is plenty of prep area for that perfect meal. There is a large sectional with big screen and comfy leather chairs to relax and read a good book or get ready for the day with that all important first cup of coffee. There is a small covered deck off the living area with a gas grill and seating so that you can enjoy our fantastic Colorado weather. Back inside at the other end of the home you will find two guest bedrooms that share a full bath in the hallway. One has a King bed and the other has two extra long twin beds.

Ready to hit the slopes in the mornings? You are in luck since they are only a few miles away! In the Summer you can hike or bike right from the property up Brush Creek which has endless opportunities.  Or take our paddle boards out and float down the Slate river. 
 Whatever the season, come see what's in store in CB!

description_text:
Set on 15 private acres at the end of a quiet road in CB South, this mountain retreat offers rare privacy, sweeping views of Whetstone Mountain, and wildlife viewing—guests have spotted bears, deer, foxes, and hummingbirds right from the property. With open living, multiple dining areas, a private suite, and dogs welcome, it’s the perfect escape.

 The space

Main Level (Entry)

        Mudroom for gear and boots

        Primary suite with king bed, private bath with walk-in shower,    and sliding glass door to a small deck

Upper Level (Main Living Area)

Outside, you’ll find 15 private acres with plenty of space to roam, relax, and enjoy complete privacy—just you, the mountains, and the stars.

Why You’ll Love It

Whether you’re sipping coffee on the deck, stargazing by the firepit, or watching your dogs explore the open space, this peaceful CB South retreat offers a true taste of mountain living. Designed for comfort and connection, it’s ideal for families, friends, and dog lovers who crave both adventure and quiet.

Highlights & Amenities

     15 private acres with panoramic views of Whetstone Mountain

     Outdoor firepit and multiple decks for stargazing or sunset views

     Pet-friendly (up to 2 dogs, $150 per pet per stay)

     High-speed internet + YouTube TV

     Open-concept living area with two dining spaces

     Fully equipped kitchen with everything you need to cook and entertain

     Jetted tub and private lower-level suite with kitchenette

     Washer and dryer for guest use

 Guest access 
Guests have full access to the entire home, including all three levels, decks, patios, laundry area, and the private firepit overlooking Whetstone Mountain. There’s ample parking on-site with space for several vehicles, and the location at the end of the road ensures total privacy.

description_text:
Experience a getaway in our lower-level apartment nestled between Gunnison and Lake City. This one-bedroom has a king-size bed, large bathroom with a soaking tub, and a kitchenette equipped with necessities. Enjoy the cozy living room with a decorative gas fireplace, Roku TV, and access to a private patio with a grill. Explore hiking trails, relax by the river nearby, and visit our farm stand for homemade goodies.
This Powderhorn is the small ranch community, not the ski resort.

 The space 
Our property is a beautiful small ranchette set in a serene mountain valley, perfect for nature lovers and those seeking a peaceful retreat. The lower-level apartment is surrounded by stunning mountain and valley views, providing a picturesque backdrop for your stay. 

You’ll find inviting amenities, including a private patio with a porch swing, a relaxing two-person hot tub, and a pellet smoker grill for outdoor cooking. The spacious grounds feature well-maintained gardens with fresh greens, herbs, and flowers during the summer months.

In addition to the apartment, our property is home to charming animals, including horses and friendly barn cats, enhancing the homestead experience. A small caretaker cabin also adds to the unique character of the property.

For adventurers, there are numerous hiking trails right outside your door, with wonderful opportunities for exploration. In winter, you can enjoy cross-country skiing on the nearby trails. A public access river is just under two miles away, perfect for fishing and enjoying nature.

Don't miss our summer farm stand, where you can find homemade soap, fresh produce, and other delightful homestead creations. Enjoy the tranquility and beauty that our property has to offer!

 Guest access 
Guest Access Information

Welcome to your home away from home! For your convenience, guests should park behind the house, next to the long log. This spot is easily accessible and provides a close entrance to the apartment.

To reach the lower-level apartment, simply take the path leading to the basement entrance. The door will typically be open upon your arrival for a seamless check-in experience. However, if the door is closed, you'll find a key conveniently placed under the welcome rug for easy access.

Once inside, you’ll have the privacy and comfort of your own space, complete with a locked door for added security. We’re excited to have you stay with us, and we’re here to assist you if you have any questions or need assistance during your visit. Enjoy your stay!

 Other things to note 
Escape to our serene lower-level apartment nestled in a picturesque mountain valley, perfect for a romantic getaway or a cozy retreat. This spacious one-bedroom unit features a luxurious king-size bed, ensuring a restful night's sleep. The large bathroom boasts a soaking tub, double vanity, and a separate roomy shower, complete with a private enclosure for the toilet.

The kitchenette is equipped with modern conveniences, including a refrigerator, microwave/convection/air fryer oven, and a hot plate. You'll find all the necessary dishes, cups, and utensils to cook simple meals during your stay.

Relax in the inviting living room, furnished with two comfy chairs and a decorative gas fireplace, perfect for warming up on chilly nights. Enjoy your favorite shows on the Roku TV or step through the double patio doors to your private patio. Here, you can unwind on the porch swing, or fire up the pellet smoker grill while taking in the stunning mountain and valley views.

Located on a small ranchette, you'll be part of a friendly atmosphere, with the property owners living above and their two lovable Golden Retrievers welcoming you. The expansive grounds are home to a caretaker cabin, horses, and barn cats, adding to the charming country experience. During the summer, delight in the garden filled with fresh greens, herbs, and blooming flowers.

Adventure awaits with hiking opportunities right at your doorstep. In winter, explore

description_text:
We call it "The Lodge" - because it's the perfect, spacious mountain retreat for groups, families, and friends exploring Gunnison. Comfortably sleeping up to 10, the home features multiple living areas, a fully equipped kitchen, and a bright enclosed sunroom perfect for morning coffee or afternoon wind-down. Minutes from downtown, Western Colorado University, and easy access to skiing, hiking, biking, and fishing. Thoughtfully furnished and professionally maintained for relaxed, memorable stays.

 Other things to note 
Welcome to your own Gunnison Mountain Lodge.

This spacious five-bedroom home is designed to feel like a true lodge getaway, even though you’re just minutes from town. Tucked at the edge of a quiet neighborhood, the property backs to acres of open horse land with sweeping mountain views, giving it a super peaceful, private feel.

Inside, the open layout makes it easy to spend time together, while still giving everyone room to spread out. With two separate living areas and five comfortable bedrooms, it’s a great fit for families, friend groups, or anyone traveling together who values both connection and personal space.

The sunroom is a favorite spot. Filled with natural light and views of the surrounding landscape, it’s perfect for slow mornings with coffee, an afternoon book, or winding down after a day outside. It’s one of those spaces that makes the house extra special. (Even on a cold winter day, if the sun is out, that sunroom can easily get up into the 70s or 80s!)

If work needs to come along for the trip, bedroom five includes two fully set up workstations, making it easy to balance remote work with mountain time.

The home is located just under ten minutes from downtown Gunnison, with easy access to restaurants, coffee shops, and local amenities. You’re also close to the free bus stop for Crested Butte, so you can skip parking hassles and enjoy the ride. Crested Butte’s skiing, hiking, and mountain biking are about 30 minutes away, while the Gunnison and Taylor Rivers, Hartman Rocks, and Blue Mesa Reservoir are all within easy driving distance.

There’s plenty of driveway parking, including space for trailers, making this a convenient base for snowmobiling, boating, or other outdoor adventures. Many guests also appreciate staying at a slightly lower elevation than Crested Butte while still being close to everything the valley offers.

Whether you’re here for winter sports, summer trails, or a quieter mountain escape, this home offers the comfort, space, and setting to make it feel like your own private lodge.

description_text:
This cozy one-bedroom cottage sits right on the river, with beautiful water views and striking cliffs across the way. Enjoy the private deck, large windows, and a calm, comfortable space. Queen bed, king pullout, and a fully equipped kitchen. Quiet yet just minutes from downtown Gunnison. Close to Hartman Rocks, Blue Mesa, and a short drive to Crested Butte for hiking, biking, and skiing year-round.

 The space 
This cozy one-bedroom cottage sits right on the river, with beautiful water views and striking cliffs just across the way. With a private deck overlooking the river and large windows that bring in natural light, the space feels calm, comfortable, and connected to its surroundings. It is an easy place to settle in, whether you are here to explore or simply enjoy the view. 

Please note the main house is located next to the cottage guest house. 

The cottage is cozy, clean, and easy. Private and surrounded by nature, but you are still just minutes from downtown Gunnison by car or by bike. The living area invites you to curl up with a book, sip your morning coffee, or just watch the river drift by. The kitchen is fully set up for cooking, with everything you’ll need. The bedroom has a queen bed, and the living room sofa pulls out into a king. The bedroom features blackout curtains for a restful night’s sleep, while all other rooms have privacy curtains for added comfort and seclusion. Big windows and sliding doors bring the outside in, so even when you are inside, you are still connected to the river and trees. 

If you are coming for the outdoors, you are in a great spot. Hartman Rocks Recreation Area is minutes away for biking and hiking, the Gunnison Whitewater Park is just down the road, and Blue Mesa Reservoir is an easy drive for boating and fishing. There is access to trails, rivers, and open space in every direction. From hiking, biking, boating, fishing, skiing or relaxing and so much more, we’ve got it all right here for you. 

Crested Butte is close by as well and absolutely worth the drive. In the summer, it is known for incredible hiking and mountain biking, with wildflower-filled alpine trails, scenic lift-access rides, and miles of singletrack. In the winter, it turns into a world-class ski destination with terrain for everything from cruisy groomers to steep, technical runs. It is one of those mountain towns you can visit year-round and always find something worth doing.

Whether you are here to get outside all day or just sit by the river and do nothing at all, this spot makes it easy to settle in and stay awhile.

 Other things to note 
The guest house is located near the main home, but it is set up to feel private and separate. You will have your own space to come and go as you please, with no shared areas. We are nearby if anything comes up or you need recommendations, but we are mindful of your stay and keep our distance so you can fully relax and enjoy your time here.

description_text:
Cozy private room at Wild Pine, our horse sanctuary tucked into the Valley. Come and settle into the slower rhythm of ranch life. 

Your private room is yours to retreat to, with access to shared spaces throughout the house and plenty of room outside to wander, sit by the river, watch the horses, or simply do nothing for a while. 

This isn't a polished resort. It's a working ranch, a horse sanctuary, and a place built around the belief that sometimes the best thing we can do is slow down.

 The space 
You'll have a private bedroom/bathroom and access to the shared living spaces, kitchen, outdoor areas, hot tub, and the land surrounding the house.

The horses are part of everyday life here. Depending on the season and what's happening around the ranch, you may see them grazing, hear them calling, or find yourself standing at the fence longer than you intended.

The Gunnison River runs nearby, and the North Fork Valley is full of little roads, trails, farms, hot springs, mountain towns, and places worth wandering.

 During your stay 
the host lives in the upstairs bedroom- there is also a hypoallergenic, well behaved goldendoodle that lives inside. A well behaved pet is welcome.

 Other things to note 
Wild Pine is a real working sanctuary, so this is a little different from staying at a traditional hotel or vacation rental.

There may be animal sounds, ranch activity, dirt, weather, and the occasional bit of beautiful chaos. That's part of the magic here.

The room is best suited for guests who appreciate quiet, nature, animals, and a place that feels a little more like home than a hotel.

Come with a book. Come with hiking boots. Come with nothing planned at all.

We'll leave the rest to the horses.

description_text:
Newly built, luxurious mountain-modern, off-grid cabin spectacularly situated above Marble, CO.

Bask among the most spectacular mountain views you'll ever encounter, through giant window walls & outside on the mammoth sun deck..Carbonite Creek National Trail awaits just steps out the front door. 

Cedar ceilings, polished concrete floors, mid-century modern furniture and luxurious accoutrements enhance the unique, decadent experience awaiting you in one of the world's most magical nature spots.

 The space 
Cabin is located 60 miles from Aspen, an 8-minute drive from the town center of Marble.

During the winter months (including Fall and Spring months during which snow has begun/accumulated), a 4-wheel drive vehicle is required. The 2.3-mile road up the mountain to the cabin is unpaved, with no guardrails and a scattering of potholes and loose rocks. 

Due to high fire danger in the valley, wood-stove use is restricted to Winter Months (November~March). Cabin has radiant heated floors to keep warm during cooler autumn nights.

PLEASE NOTE: Driveway is of a steep grade, has loose gravel, and not regularly plowed in winter-- guests are thus NOT to drive down it when snow-covered/Wintertime (this follows several guests getting stuck, including in rented Jeeps--causing great inconvenience and a missed plane)--Guests can park at the top of the driveway and walk down. High heels are highly advised against when walking up or down the driveway any time of year. Also, this could present a problem for handicapped or elderly guests who may require assistance, when parking at the top of the driveway. 

Starlink internet wi-fi service recently installed, allowing for cellphone usage while at the cabin--based on this the cabin no longer has a landline telephone. There's no cable/satellite TV but there is a large variety of DVDs of multiple genres, along with multiple board games, telescope/binoculars.  

PLEASE NOTE: The Soaking Tub in the bedroom is not operational.

 Guest access 
The entire habitable cabin space.

 Other things to note 
The Cabin is perched up above the town of Marble; at 8,800ft it's the highest property available for vacation stays in the area. For those of us who have forgotten what a multitude of stars looks like,  the Rocky Mountains surrounding Marble offer an immersion into lost wonders of contemporary life. Untrammeled snow. Unsullied air. A velvet cloak of silence.

description_text:
Come experience the Freedom of the Hills. You'll love staying in this charming and quaint home.  Enjoy being nestled in the mountains, yet conveniently close to both Crested Butte and Gunnison. Experience the best of what Colorado has to offer; fish, boat, bike, and off-road within moments of walking out the door. Ski the epic powder at Mt. Crested Butte in the winter, hike and enjoy the wildflowers in the summer or just hang out in the yard and relax in the hot tub. Our place has got it all!

 The space 
Our sweet little home is in Taylor Canyon, just North of Almont, CO on Highway 742. Located near the confluence of Spring Creek and the Taylor River, our place sits on 2.5 acres of land in one of most picturesque areas of Colorado. Highway 742 sees very little action during the wintertime months, but can be on the busy side of things during the summer.  Its convenience allows you to easily access all the best attractions of the area.  In the summertime, Gunnison and Crested Butte are only a 25 minute drive away and both of these places boast excellent recreational, dining and shopping opportunities.   During the winter time, driving is slower and some of the short cut roads to Crested Butte are closed. So, expect the drive to CB to be more like a 40 minute trip through magical scenery.  It's up to you to choose your own adventure and then retreat to a peaceful and cozy home.

You'll have the entire home to yourself. This home was built in 2007 and has all new furnishings. The upstairs bedroom has beautiful views of the craggy rock outcroppings that line the property.   This bedroom boasts a full bath with a double headed shower for a unique bathing experience!  

The kitchen is stocked with all the amenities you'll need to cook a delicious meal. Warm and cozy with a big deck and a woodstove; we have an outdoor fire ring and seating area, just uphill from the cabin - you'll see a gravel trail to it and some red chairs up there. We just had a huge forestry project at the property, so there is a ton of wood left on the ground that needs to be burned - any wood/branches you see on the ground is good to burn (fire conditions allowing)!  The subdivision roads are unpaved, so please use AWD or 4WD vehicles in the summer in case it gets muddy from summer thunderstorms.  In the winter the house is accessible by snowmobile, snow bike, snowshoeing or skiing ONLY and guests must verify what transportation they have for getting to the cabin from the parking area (it's a 1.3 mile trip on snow-cat-packed roads).  Ask about a snowmobile shuttle for your gear in and out at the beginning and end of your winter stay if you are not using your own snow machines our human-powered gear to access the cabin.

 Guest access 
This cabin is in Pitkin |(NOT Almont - Google maps is wrong!).  Pitkin is a listed Bird Sanctuary and you can enjoy watching birds in all seasons here. The Pitkin area is very popular in the summer and guests can ride their bikes or OHVs right into town on a subdivision off-pavement road, then on to area trails from there.

description_text:
This very charming two-bedroom, two-bath Guest house is located on one of the most scenic by-ways in the State of Colorado and is quaint from head to toe! The Hummingbirds are incredible. They migrate here from South America to breed in the summer. The wildlife is abundant. There are deer, elk, foxes, etc. The views are amazing and all the other gifts shared with us by Mother Nature are breathtaking. This property was used as a very successful Bed and Breakfast from 1994 to 2003.

 The space 
The guest house is separate from the main house and consists of a bedroom and bath with a shower on the main floor with a private entrance and small sitting deck. It has a queen bed. There is also a combination washer/dryer in the bathroom. On the main floor, there is a living room, a kitchen area with a microwave, stove, and refrigerator, and a second bathroom with a tub and shower. The second bedroom is upstairs and has two queen beds, with enough space for a folding bed, if required. This guest house can sleep up to eight people but is better suited for six adults or a family with children. Please note, no amenities specifically for children such as a crib or playpen are provided. The cabin may not be childproof to everyone's standard, so please keep an eye on your adventurous little ones. The cabin is totally stocked with amenities (pots and pans, toaster, coffee pot, blender, bedding, towels, etc.) You are renting only the guest house and not the main house. The owners live onsite in the main house, with two large dogs. Expect to be greeted by barking, it helps keep the wildlife away.

 Guest access 
You're in the middle of nowhere, Colorado. At the same time, you're within an hour of Aspen, 40 minutes from Glenwood Springs hot springs, and under 30 minutes from Carbondale's theater and shopping. 10 minutes away from Redstone, and down the street from 2 hot springs, Avalanche Ranch and Penny hot springs, which is free.

Any outdoor activity you're looking for, we can help you find! ATV/snowmobile rentals are available directly from us, horseback riding, fly fishing, hiking, or just barbequing and relaxing!

You're welcome to explore the surrounding Countryside, wonderful Mountain vistas, and Crystal river flowing a couple of hundred feet away.

 Other things to note 
Please be aware this is a cabin in the woods, a really nice and well-appointed one, but still a cabin in the woods. There are all kinds of little critters and big wild life all around us, and we have to share their space. Please be prepared to see a mouse, or a fox, or deer, or a bear! Obviously, we do everything we can to keep them out of the cabin itself, but they could always find a way inside if they're determined enough. We're 25 miles from Carbondale's downtown or a real grocery store, or gas station. There isn't any cell phone reception here, or cable TV, no Netflix, no Dish, just a remote for the DVD player and lots of movies. There are no landlines in the cabin. If you need to make a call, we suggest WiFi calling on your smartphone. If you need any help getting it to work, just come ask. We'll be glad to assist you. 
Additionally, we have plenty of board games and movies, so you can stay entertained no matter the weather.

 The space 
Perched high on a hillside overlooking the beautiful Crystal Valley, our home offers breathtaking mountain views, peaceful surroundings, and a true escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

The home is a duplex, with guests enjoying private use of the spacious upper level. The separate downstairs unit is not rented to other guests, but owners may occasionally visit and use this space with advance notice.

Up to two well-behaved dogs are welcome with prior approval. Please don't hesitate to reach out with any questions about the property or planning your stay. We're always happy to help!

 Guest access 
Parking & Driveway

Our mountain driveway is steep and rocky in some areas, so please use caution when arriving and parking.

During the winter months, please do not drive to the upper portion of the driveway near the walkout basement. The hillside can become extremely slippery, and vehicles may become stuck. Guests are welcome to park anywhere in the lower parking area.

Accessing the Home

Summer Access: Guests may use the natural stone steps leading up to the home, or the pathway that wraps around the left side of the house.

Winter Access: For your safety, PLEASE DO NOT use the stone steps when snow or ice is present! They become extremely slippery and hazardous.

Instead, follow the pathway that wraps around the left side of the house to reach the entrance. Please be aware that you will need to carry your luggage a short distance uphill from the parking area.

We recommend sturdy, weather-appropriate footwear, especially during the winter months.

 Other things to note 
Cell Service & Connectivity

IMPORTANT: There is NO reliable cell phone reception in Marble! Please download directions and any important travel information before arriving. We recommend enabling Wi-Fi calling on your phone prior to your trip.

High Altitude

Our home sits at approximately 8,200 feet above sea level. Guests arriving from lower elevations may experience symptoms of altitude sickness, including headaches, fatigue, or shortness of breath. We recommend staying hydrated, taking it easy upon arrival, and allowing time to acclimate.

Power Outages

As with many remote mountain communities, occasional power outages can occur, particularly during storms. If the power goes out, you can check whether the Marble Hub has electricity and internet access. The Hub offers free Wi-Fi, with connection information posted on the outside window. It is located across the street from Slow Groovin' BBQ.

Remote Mountain Living

Marble is a small, secluded mountain community with limited nearby services. We recommend arriving with groceries, fuel, and any essential supplies you'll need during your stay. Mountain weather can change quickly, so please check road and weather conditions before traveling.

UTV'S & SNOWMOBILES AVAILABLE TO RENT OR BRING YOURS. Add a DOT COM to Alpineplateau for website.

 The space 
The Cabin(house) is everything you'd think it should be. VERY comfortable with electric or wood stove for heat, (we supply the wood) Electricity, running water, bathrooms...just like your house, only difference is it is in the woods, and that is so cool.

And it is at 9,000 feet of smog free, crystal clear mountain air. There is also a nice large fire pit (USE MAY BE LIMITED) and 3 private, no license required, fishing lakes within 10 minutes of the house.

And it's our second home, so everything, including our clothes, are there.
As well as games, books, silly decorations, bear rug on the wall, as well as several animal mounts. Deer, antelope, badger, pheasant, and more are mounted thru out.

1,000 square feet is the main floor and 400 sq feet up in the loft. Two Queen beds downstairs, a queen and two twins upstairs. We've slept 17 there one CHRISTmas. A lot of little kids.

 Guest access 
Once you arrive at the "Alpine Plateau Road" (off Hwy 50, county road 867) you are approx. 5.5 miles, on a well maintained dirt road, from the Cabin. Go_ogle maps will take you right to it. 3 right hand turns and your there. Go_ogle Earth also will give you a great birds eye view of the cabin and surrounding area.

You have access to 1000's of acres of land. 4 privately owned lakes. Our property sits on 3 acres and you'll never see as many stars that you can see at 9,000 feet. And our "Grey Jays" (cousin to the Blue Jay) will literally eat out of your out stretched hand. Try it, the kids love it.

Weather plays a huge roll when your elevation is over 9,000 feet. As summer winds down, be very aware of the forecasts, as they can change very quickly.

Cell phone service, at the cabin, works great with AT&T, not so much with others.  WiFi and Direct TV is included.

FOOD. The nearest store is 30+ miles away. Shop before you arrive. In a pinch the Arrowhead Lodge (5 miles away)  have a very limited list of things available. Milk, soda's, bread, cheese. Be safe, bring your own.

description_text:
Romantic and Spacious 2 Bedroom European style Mountain Chalet with modern chef's kitchen including granite counter tops, farmhouse sink, dishwasher and heated stone floors. Listen to the sound of the river while relaxing in the comfortable king size beds or on the private deck of the master bedroom. Enjoy the magical mountain and river views of the upper Crystal River Valley.  You have officially arrived in paradise. A quiet, private and absolutely gorgeous property w/ Starlink high speed WiFi.

 The space 
The upper bath includes his and her sinks with water fall faucets, stone countertops and a European bidet. A wood burning fireplace graces the living room to keep you warm and cozy.

 Conveniently located at the base of stunning mountain peaks with incredible 360 degree views both inside and out. A large and comfortable covered entry patio and a wrap around sunny south deck accessed through French doors from the living room.

Design reflects a European Alps decor with hand carved trim and woodworking details of old world character. Enjoy the stone fireplace and comfortable hearth while viewing snowy mountain peaks thousands of feet directly above.

Lots of parking, easy access, all day sun, located at the end of the road in a quiet neighborhood 2 miles before the town of Marble.

THIS is THE PERFECT mountain getaway for summer or winter. The sky is the limit for fun in the surrounding mountains. Hike to the nearby Marble falls or a longer trek to Crested Butte or the Snowmass/Maroon Bells wilderness area. Mountain Bike or ATV to the historic town of Crystal for lunch at the Crystal Mill on the edge of the Crystal River. Kids love to go fishing at the stocked Beaver Lake in the heart of town or stop to see the giant blocks of white marble that were used to build the Lincoln Monument. Walk the paths at the Marble Mill Site park to go back in history to see the ruins of the old Marble Mill.

For the more adventurous, in the summer, float or kayak the class III / IV Rapids on the Crystal River through Bogan Canyon . In the amazing powder filled winters, enjoy world class back country skiing on nearby Raspberry Ridge & Marble Peak. Ice climbing is also a popular winter sports activity for the experienced climber in the Crystal River valley.

For a day of rest take a drive to the top of McClure Pass for incredible year round mountain vistas, then head to Redstone (approx 8miles) for a tour of the historic Redstone Castle followed by lunch on the patio of the Redstone Inn. You and your friends can also unwind and relax in the natural hot springs at

Avalanche Ranch Hot Springs & Antiques or take a dip at the roadside Penny Hot Springs on the edge of Hwy 133 where

You can often observe groups of Rocky Mtn. Big Horn Sheep and herds of Elk across the river in the protected Fiola Meadows Preserve. Come enjoy the best of the Colorado Rockies in the quiet comfort of this amazing property.
View less

 Guest access 
The entire home.

 Other things to note 
There is zero cell service in Marble, which is great. Gives you a chance to get away and recharge. We do have WiFi to stay connected via text and email. Also our house phone only makes local calls out, but anyone can call in. We will give you the phone number upon request.

description_text:
The Crested Butte Loft is a spacious three-story condo with two bedrooms, a sleeper sofa, and two and a half bathrooms that accommodates up to seven guests. Relax in mountain comfort, while enjoying easy access to town.
The CB Loft features a modern kitchen, dining area,  a bar, and balconies with stunning views of Mt. Crested Butte, Whetstone Mountain, and Axtell Peak. There are three cozy sitting areas, a game room with foosball and a dartboard, plus a loft playroom for kids.

 The space 
EASY ACCESS TO TOWN
Take the Crested Butte Town Shuttle from nearby Mountaineer Square. It’s a five-minute walk from the Loft. Then, enjoy a quick ride to explore the charming, historic town. Or, you can access town by strolling down the scenic recreation path. Bikes are welcome. No matter what adventure you pick in Crested Butte, you'll love the comfort and ideal location of The Crested Butte Loft.

STAYING ON THE MOUNTAIN
You’ll find many local hot spots steps from the Loft. Enjoy a latte at Coffee Lab, food and specialty drinks at A Bar Above, or homemade Third Bowl Ice Cream at Tin Cup. For modern Mexican, visit José and relax at the outdoor bar. Or grab a bite at the Crested Butte Burger Co.

SUMMER
During summer, step out onto your balcony and take in the resort stage, where you can watch musicians performing at the Music on the Mountain series every Wednesday evening. With mountain bike trails right outside your door, the Red Lady chair lift operates all summer to cater to downhill biking enthusiasts. Or, ride the Silver Queen chair lift for a panoramic view of the town from the top of Mt. Crested Butte on the popular Peak Hike. Hiking and biking trails suitable for all skill levels are accessible from the base area, or nearby trailheads like Snodgrass and the Upper Loop.

WINTER
In winter, you can step outside your door and hit the lifts. You'll be on the mountain, making first tracks in the amazing CB powder.

IRWIN GUIDES DISCOUNT
As our guests, you'll receive an exclusive discount code to use when booking an unforgettable experience with our partners, Irwin Backcountry Guides. In winter, explore backcountry skiing, ice climbing, snowshoeing, Nordic skiing, and more. Enhance your spring, summer, or fall stay in Crested Butte with a guided adventure, such as fly fishing, rafting, rock climbing, mountain biking, hiking, or backpacking. Irwin Guides are experts at creating lifelong memories for you and your friends and family.

GETTING HERE
The Crested Butte Loft is located on the third floor of the Axtel building, directly across from the resort's two main chair lifts at the base area of Crested Butte Mountain Resort.

description_text:
Unobstructed view of the majestic Butte, instead of looking past others rooftops, make this home the perfect place to relax and soak in the beauty of Crested Butte. Perfectly located just 7 min from town and the Ski area. It shares a fence line with ranch land where deer, and fox play in the wild flowers within yards of the deck. Enjoy private fishing & water sports at Meridian Lake and a short walk to Long Lake for more fishing & water fun. Access to hiking/biking trails from the front door.

 The space 
This house was built to bring the outside in!  The View House is located on ranch land fence line so instead of seeing the rooftops of other houses, you see only the majestic Butte and open land, making you feel like you are the only people in Crested Butte. Beautiful views from every window of the house.  Relax in the living room with the beautiful gas fireplace and views of the Butte hovering just outside the floor to ceiling windows.  The kitchen is well appointed and has everything you'll need to make great meals to share with family and friends. The large dining room has a table that seats 8 people and 6 more places at the counter and bar.

The deck provides a  wonderful place to take in the beauty of the area.  Wildlife abounds on the ranch land that boarders the house.  Bring your binoculars for a close up view of the deer, fawns, fox, and other animals that live and play right outside your door.  Grill the perfect steak and dine on the deck while the setting sun lights up the Butte.  When the sun sets, stay warm around the gas fire pit, or soak in the hot tub, and enjoy the starlit sky. 

The Master Bedroom is located upstairs on the opposite side of the house from the other two bedrooms.  In addition to the large in suite bathroom, the master includes it's own fireplace, sitting area, and TV.  It is the perfect place to steal away for some quality time away from others in the house. It also boasts it's own private deck with the same great views of the butte.  This is a great place for that first cup of coffee in the morning or a glass of wine before bed. 

Bedroom 2 is nicely furnished with a King bed.  It also has it's own in suite bathroom with a large walk in shower, long vanity, and walk in closet.  No worries if you get this bedroom instead of the master.  In this room you don't even have to get out of bed to enjoy the spectacular view.  Breakfast in bed maybe?

Bedroom 3 has a queen bed and the large bathroom is directly across the hall.  The windows point toward the north with great views of Gothic Mountain.  This bedroom has a walk-in closet as well.

The loft is located at the top of the stairs, and just outside the master bedroom.  It is equipped with full size bunk beds and a daybed that has a single trundle bed underneath that can be pulled out to accommodate another person.

The house includes a full size laundry room with washer, dryer and utility sink.

The deck provides a wonderful place for outdoor dining, wildlife viewing, and stargazing. A gas firepit is available in summer months. 

The house has a 2-car attached garage but guests can't park inside.  The house was constructed in the 1980's so the bays accommodate only small vehicles. We store our Razor and motorcycles here so there's not a lot of room but is a great place to store your summer and winter toys such as skis and bikes.

 Guest access 
You will have access to the entire house and garage.  The garage is designed for two small cars but we have motorcycles and a Razor stored in the garage making it a little tight. (Razor & motorcycles are not for guest use)  It will still easily accommodate your toys such as bikes, skis, and water toys.

 Other things to note 
There are a lot of people who are full time residence in the Meridian Lake subdivision.  They are friendly folks and like sharing their beautiful neighborhood with visitors.  However, there are some rules that they can get a little nitpicky about.

description_text:
Longing for a spacious place to enjoy fresh mountain air and dark star-filled skies? Welcome to our updated 4 Bdrm, 3.5 Bath mountain home with plenty of room for the whole family and conveniently located right between downtown and the ski resort (4 min drive to each).  Come take in the expansive and unobstructed views of both the butte and CB valley while sipping coffee on the massive deck or while soaking in the brand-new hot tub after a day on the slopes or on the adjacent Nordic Trail. 
.

 The space 
This new to the market home is a unique, private stone and log home completely refurbished in a modern, clean style.  The 1440 square ft viewing porch is directly adjacent to open property conserved by the CB Land Trust and provides views of the town of Crested Butte surrounded by mountains and the valley beyond.  You will enjoy unobstructed views of the 12,168 ft Butte and a nighttime view of the Milky Way from the 8 person hot tub or while warming by the Solo stainless steel fire pit.  Perfect for families, the home is situated on enough land to allow plenty of space for sledding, family snowball fights, summer football and even sleeping under the stars. Large enough to find some quiet places to read a book, nap in a hammock or enjoy your wine or cocoa in front of a cozy fire. 
Four bedrooms include two master bedrooms with large en suite bathrooms featuring soaking tubs and showers. One queen bedroom and a bunk room with four beds.  The basement provides two additional beds and a TV, perfect for a kid's hang-out space.  All bedrooms have views and doors that open to the porch.  
The living space features soaring ceilings and windows in the classic alpine style with breathtaking views. There are two fireplaces in the home, dining seating for ten at our vintage French table and a cook's kitchen. Technology includes key-less entry, four TVs streaming YouTubeTV, Netflix and Disney +, high speed internet  and a private office space for your remote work meetings.  Three full baths and a half bath are stocked with luxury towels and soap and bath products. There is a large separate utility room in the basement and ample parking out front.

Bedroom Specifics as follows:
  Master Suite (Butte Side) - King Bed, seating area, fireplace, TV, door to back porch, en suite bathroom (separate tub and shower), large walk in closet - Main Floor
  Bedroom 2 - Queen Size Bed, writing desk, bathroom with shower across the hall, door to back porch- Main Floor 
  Bedroom 3 - Two Bunk Beds (four twin beds), bathroom with shower across the hall, door to back porch - Main Floor
 Master Suite (Town Side) King Bed, seating area, TV, en suite bathroom (separate tub and shower), door to back porch, large walk in closet - Main Floor
 Basement - One twin bed and twin trundle bed, TV

 Guest access 
Firewood is stored in the garage, but at this time guests will park out front in the large parking area. There is not sufficient space for guests to park in the garage at this time.
