description_text:
3 Bedroom and Common Space close to the Taylor River Sleeps 12

 The space 
Welcome to The Getaway at TaylorMade, our home that is the perfect getaway for your family! Nestled in the canyon along the Taylor River and the majestic Rocky Mountains, this lofty mountain grandeur displays God’s artistry unlike any other. Relax and enjoy the beauty surrounding you, making memories for a lifetime.
When you first come into the home you will want to remove your shoes and warm your feet as you walk into the main living room that is joined by the open kitchen.  There is a half bath that provides those essential needs without having to go into a bedroom. The master bedroom/bathroom is right off of the living room with a King bed. This spacious bedroom/bathroom is convenient for all who do not want to have to venture up and down the stairs.
Downstairs will greet you with a nice area for the kids to sleep (bunk bed (lower bed is a queen) and two different fold-out couches, one a queen and the other a twin) and a play area with Pool/Raquetball table. This area also has a "bar" area with a mini-refrigerator and sink. To the left and right of the "bar" are two different bedrooms (King mattresses) each with its own full bathroom.
This home sleeps 12 for that fun family/friend get-together. Have a great time exploring the 7 acres outside/behind the home! A short walk (about 800 yards ;) and across the street to the Taylor River where you can fish your way to lunch in Almont, then fish your way back home again. 
In order to provide everyone the opportunity to experience this majestic place, there is a ramp in the garage so all can enter this home and enjoy the clean mountain air. Let nothing stop you!

If you need more room for a bigger party book "Taylormade Hideaway" at the same time and your whole group can enjoy this entire property alone/together. They are neighboring properties, sharing the same driveway, Taylormade just for you.

Due to the carpet throughout, NO PETS: This home is allergy-free! Please do not rent if you need to bring your dog
Under Colorado state law
HB16-1426, it is a crime to knowingly misrepresent a companion, assistance, or emotional support animal to avoid pet fees or have an animal in housing that otherwise does not allow pets.

 Guest access 
You access the house with the code provided above then hit the checkmark on the lower-left corner. To activate the keypad, place your hand in front of the black pad by the handle. To LOCK the door simply touch YALE
Check-in is 4pm mountain time. If you come early your access may not work. You can use your code from 4pm of your arrival date until 10 am on your departure date

Please do not drive on the lawn, thank you!

Fire pit- please be very mindful that this is a pine forest. This means you are sitting in the middle of a matchbox! Please do not build any fires other than in the fire pit that is established. 

Please adhere to our strictly enforced NO SMOKING (Tobacco or Marijuana).
Check-Out Time- 10:00 AM at the latest; unless a “guaranteed late check-out” was purchased in advance.

description_text:
Welcome to the Long Lake Lodge! This stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5 bathroom will grace the rental market for the first time in March 2021.

This property is located in the Meridian Lake/Pristine Point subdivision of Crested Butte; just a short drive to the town of CB or the base area in Mt. Crested Butte. The real adventure awaits much closer to the home with thousands of miles of mountain biking and backcountry skiing right out the front door, not to mention Long Lake (a local favorite).

 The space 
**Please read and agree to all of the disclosures at the bottom of the listing description prior to submitting a booking request.**

*No parties/events allowed - this is a quiet, peaceful subdivision of Crested Butte that will not tolerate excessive noise*

The Long Lake Lodge is a home away from home for the whole family. Ample sleeping room for 10 guests and 3.5 bathrooms allow everybody their privacy while remaining together. 

Park in the garage or in the spacious turnaround before entering into the first floor space. The first floor was recently remodeled in the spring of 2024! This open floor plan includes a fully-stocked kitchen facing the dining and living areas so you can be "part of the action" while cooking a meal for the family. Starter supply of standard coffee is provided. 

Take in the surrounding mountain views from the dining table that offers seating for 6 (extra chairs provided). The living room includes a cozy electric fireplace as well as books, movies, games, and plenty of space for activities :)

Up the stairs awaits the sleeping quarters including the master bedroom with a king-size bed, en-suite full bathroom, and private electric fireplace. Two additional bedrooms include plenty of space, queen sized beds, and a full bathroom in the hallway near the fully stocked laundry room.

Finally, the kids room. This space will be a BIG DEAL to your kiddos as it offers a total of 4 bunks (4 twins) and 2 additional trundle roll-out twins for separate sleeping if necessary. This room also has an en-suite bath to keep all the littles nice and clean after a day of muddy/snowy trails! 

Disclosures:

GENERAL LIABILITY WAIVER: By submitting a booking request, renter agrees to abide by terms and conditions of the General Liability Waiver: Non-Owner Occupants (NOO). Renters are subject to any fines imposed by the HOA during their stay. Fines will be collected through the Resolution Center.

(The pet fee will automatically apply at the time of booking when the pet is included as a guest). Your dog must be crated in your absence. If your dog becomes a nuisance (barking, aggressive behavior, etc.), you will be asked to vacate immediately and no refund will be offered. Any damage found will be charged to the guest immediately through the AirBnb Resolution Center. The HOA has strict policies regarding nuisance behavior from pets and any board member can ask that you leave. If you are found to be in violation of these rules, there will be a minimum fee assessed of $500.00. Dogs MUST be leashed when not on the property. Our top priority is protecting the peaceful nature of this neighborhood for the long-term locals who live there. You must pick up after your pet, rain or shine - blizzard or no blizzard.

name: Classic Colorado cabin escape in Marble, Colorado
description: 270-degree mountain views near Marble
description_text:
Looking for a quiet escape with incredible views?  This cabin, 60 miles from Aspen overlooks the town of Marble. It is easy to access without a 4WD vehicle and offers full electricity, a shower, and flushing toilets.

Perfect for a couple or family of four, it offers hiking, biking, fishing, and off-roading. Enjoy the Slow Groovin' Cafe or cook at the fully stocked cabin.

 The space 
This beautiful cabin is located exactly 60 miles from Aspen and is butted up to the Aspen Snowmass Wilderness.
It offers a quiet solitude that is unmatched!
The cabin offers a priceless 270 degree mountain view with 
hiking, biking, canoeing, fishing, horseback riding and rivers and lakes to play in! It has a full kitchen with everything needed for a gourmet chef along with an outdoor weber gas grill. New this summer we have installed Wi-Fi for our guests.
The cabin is furnished by most of Barbara Walters log-framed furniture and cabinets.
The main floor has a bedroom with a queen size bed and the loft has a king size bed along with two down-filled couches that comfortably sleeps two people.
It has a antique claw foot bath/shower along with a separate toilet room. It has a huge dining room table and a full kitchen. The cabin is off the grid and is powered by a photovoltaic battery system along with a propane generator that automatically starts when the load requires it.

Downstairs has a recreational room with a pool/ping pong table and a sleeper couch.
There are a plethora of hiking/biking trails along with some great 4WD roads with access to some beautiful hikes to lakes.

It has a large deck with a dining table for breakfasts, lunches and nice evening dinners.

 Guest access 
Our guests have access to everything in the cabin

 Other things to note 
It's a very quaint and beautiful escape!

description_text:
This beautiful, spacious, and quiet 3 bed, 2.5 bath townhome is an ideal home-away-from-home. Complete with Tesla 220-V charger and heated garage. Located in the heart of the CB South Commercial District you’re a stone’s throw from Cement Creek Rd where many biking and hiking trails originate. And you’re only 20 minutes to Almont for world-class fishing. Strong and consistent wifi is a bonus.

 The space 
Oh my – the VIEWS! Whether traveling with other families on vacation; enjoying an extended-weekend escape or reconnecting with old friends on a destination vacation -- we’ve got you covered. This newer 2,200 sq ft. (3 bd 2.5 ba built in 2005) end-unit townhome is quiet, roomy, comfortable, clean, and stylish. Radiant in-floor heating in combination with high-end finishes, new furniture, new towels, and linens will warm you from the inside-out. There are 3 bedrooms, two full bathrooms, one half-bath, a large washer/dryer set, and a heated two-car garage perfect for drying out ski boots and ski clothing, storing mountain bikes, or camping gear. You can relish in the bright east-facing third (top) floor living room, where you’ll be greeted by the morning sun pouring in the oversized window and filling vaulted ceilings. The open floor plan allows everyone to spread-out and sink into oversized chairs and couches that overlook hundreds of acres of protected forest land along Cement Creek. The room’s hand-built rock gas fireplace also offers instant heat when needed after a chilly hike or day on the slopes.

Your evenings can be spent enjoying meals in a well-appointed west-facing kitchen and dining area. The dining area seats 6 adults with 4 additional seats in the nook, and 3 more chairs at the bar. Together your whole group will enjoy a front-seat ticket to sunset views over Mt.CB and Paradise Divide. The cozy west-facing deck is also accessed from this floor. It has a small grill and offers a nice place for an afternoon or evening drink.

SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS
Our bed configuration offers a tremendous amount of flexibility for various sleeping arrangements to accommodate many scenarios...1 to 3 couples, 1 or 2 families, a large family, extended family, groups of friends, etc.!

On the first floor – off the entry – is a secluded and spacious master suite. The generous room includes a queen bed and a pull-out couch (twin) sofa. It’s perfect for families with small children. The second floor includes two bedrooms and a full bath. One bedroom has a queen and plenty of space to spread out. The second bedroom has bunk beds that could sleep several kids, or a couple adults. The bunk includes: 1-twin; 1-full; and 1-twin trundle.

There is a Pack & Play crib, mattress & sheets on site. A high-chair and hiking backpack are available as well.

 Guest access 
LOCATION & ACCESS
Located in the heart of the CB South Commercial District your steps from Tully’s (an iconic restaurant/bar), the skating rink, tennis courts, coffee shop, nordic trails, hiking & biking trails, parks and much more!  If you’re looking to mix-it-up in downtown CB, the free mtn/town bus stop is only a few minute walk-away.     

PARKING
Guests have access to two parking spots: one in the garage and another outside for our unit.  **Important** the garage will not fit a cartop carrier.  If you are traveling with a carrier, please let us know and we can advise you on how to orient your car in front (outside) of the garage door.

 Other things to note 
The base price reflects a stay for 6 guests (primary renter must be 27-years old), as we try and make it economical for a smaller group to stay here. We allow for more than 6 guests,  but we charge $50/guest/night for anyone above 6 guests. This helps us compensate for more guests' additional costs, mainly water, energy, waste, and cleaning services.  

Please ensure the proper number of guests is in your reservation. Any undisclosed guests above the base price of 6 guests will be charged double per night. All we ask is for you

Beautiful mountain log cabin will give you the Colorado experience!  Above 9,000 feet in elevation the cabin is surrounded by acres of aspen and pine forest, mountain lakes and wildlife. Absolutely awesome for those who want to get away from it all and enjoy the quiet woods.  In Spring, Summer and Fall there is excellent hiking, fishing, hunting, riding dirt bikes, ATV's and 4-wheeling.  Winter is a wonderland and an amazing place to snowshoe, cross country ski or snow mobile. Pets allowed.

 The space 
This beautiful ranch style log cabin has an open floor plan. Each room has large windows for viewing the forest and wildlife.  Oak flooring is throughout the cabin. The very large covered front porch is a great place to watch wildlife or sit back and relax. This porch has an outdoor grill, tables and lots of seating including rocking chairs and a swing. On the east side of the cabin is a sun deck for your enjoyment, and at the backdoor is another large, covered porch with table and chairs for your relaxation. There is a firepit for campfires and nighttime relaxing.

The kitchen is modern with all the amenities you would need; granite counter tops, double door refrigerator with freezer, dishwasher, two ovens, microwave, Keurig coffee maker. The kitchen is fully stocked with dishes, glasses, silverware, pots, pans, crock pot, blender, toaster, cooking utensils, spices, coffee, and tea.

 The dining area has a beautiful aspen table for eight. The dining room table is ideal for the selection of games and puzzles kept at the cabin. 

 In the living room area is a wood stove with plenty of split wood and fire starter. Living room seating includes a couch, love seat, and two recliners. The smart, large screen tv includes Disney, Netflix, and Roku. There is a DVD player for those that want to watch movies or play music. Free WIFI is available for your cell phone and computer.

The two bedrooms each have beautiful aspen framed queen beds. The main bathroom has a bathtub with shower, and granite topped vanity. The washer and dryer are in the main bathroom. There is an additional half bath located off the great room.

Nearby adventures include Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park, Blue Mesa Reservoir (the largest lake in Colorado), the majestic San Juan Mountains, and Silver Jack Reservoir (where True Grit was filmed) and the towns of Montrose, Ouray, Telluride, Crested Butte and Gunnison.

In winter you can cross-country ski or snowshoe out the door. In summer you can go hiking, biking, use your ATV, and go fishing for free at 3 fishing ponds.
Nearby is the Arrowhead Mountain Lodge including a restaurant, bar and live music. 

Arrowhead Adventures rents ATVs in summer and snowmobiles in winter. Shuttle to cabin in winter may be arranged.

 Guest access 
Roads inside Arrowhead are closed (Dec 7-Mid May) open only to snowmobiles, skis, snowshoes.  Local snowmobile rentals and rides from winter parking lot to cabin are available if reserved in advance.
The cabin is within Arrowhead, a mountain home community located between Gunnison and Montrose, south of Highway 50 on the Alpine Plateau Road. Guests have access to entire home and property. Guests also have access to all hiking trails and fishing lakes in Arrowhead. 
From May into November the cabin is accessible by car. When there is adequate snow, usually late November, the roads within Arrowhead close to car and truck traffic. When the internal roads are closed, you need to park at the winter parking lot and traverse the remaining half mile to the cabin by snowmobile, snowshoe, or skis. Snowmobiles can be rented from Arrowhead Mountain Adventures located next to the Arrowhead Mountain Inn. Snowmobile shuttle service can be arranged for additional fees.

 Other things to note 
Pets are welcome. There is a $25 pet fee.

description_text:
Nestled at 8,580 feet in one of the best kept secret valleys between Gunnison and Montrose, relax in an authentic family log cabin with views that will take your breath away.  While a little rustic, all the creature comforts are there and we are adding little refinements all the time. Great for quiet reflective retreats, but also connected to high-speed internet so you can remote work. We would love to share it with responsible guests as we want it to be a blessing for others.

 The space 
This is a down to earth modest family log cabin that we have been restoring, not a luxury log home. Because of our British and Norwegian family connections, we have named it Fjellheimen - which translated from Norwegian is 'Mountain Home'. We hope if you chose to stay a few nights or even a couple of weeks, that you find our little mountain home in the fresh clean air of the rockies as restorative as we have. 

Far away from city lights and distractions, our little mountain home is 12 miles up a well maintained county road and is about 45 minutes from our nearest town. We have incredible drinking water from a mountain spring and all the other usual modern refinements such as electricity and central heat. We would describe this cabin as ideal for those who want to experience some level of country living in a rustic log cabin without roughing it.

 Guest access 
Year round access is maintained, but in the winter all wheel or four wheel drive vehicles are highly advised because sometimes it takes a bit for the road to be plowed after a major storm. Late spring, summer and autumn, cars are suitable.

** Please note, cell phones don't work at the cabin, so you will need to use our WiFi  or give out the cabin number to your friends to make contact.

 Other things to note 
Located in the Big Cimarron Valley between Gunnison and Montrose, a few miles up the road from our cabin are thousands of acres of National Forest and BLM.  Lake and stream fishing can be done with a license and there are many trails, some of which lead to 14k peaks to be climbed, with the most popular being Uncompahgre. 

If you enjoy ATVing, there are a few trails up the valley and the East, Middle and West Fork Valleys are definitely worth exploring. If you wish to explore old ghost towns and  4 x 4 ing is your thing, a popular thing to do is to go over Owl Creek pass, drop into Ridgeway, then head to Silverton to take the Alpine Loop through Animas Forks to Lake City and then return via Blue Mesa. 

This is also the filming grounds of the original John Wayne True Grit movie - so you can watch it in our DVD player and then do a day trip to visit the sites in the area. (websearch for 'True Grit, Then and Now, John Wayne filming locations').

You will likely never run out of things to do, and if in the rare chance you do, just sit on the deck and soak up the beautiful views in the fresh mountain air!

description_text:
This cozy mountain getaway is located in the heart of the Colorado San Juan Mountain Range, halfway between Montrose and Gunnison off Hwy50. This cabin has all the comforts of home, but set apart at 9,000 ft. elevation surrounded by acres of quaking aspen, majestic pines, natural mountain lakes and wildlife. Paradise to all the hikers, bikers, ATV'ers, fisherman, hunters, snowmobilers, and cross-country skiers out there! Come, stay, re-charge and enjoy all that nature has to offer!

 The space 
This 3,000 sq. ft. cabin features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and a loft with 2 sets of bunkbeds. It can accommodate up to 12 guests. Whether you want to host a large family gathering or enjoy the space with friends, there is more than enough room to accommodate. Kids will love the bunk room in the loft with attached playroom, private bathroom, and smart television and DVD player for movies (bring your own movies). The master features a king bed with private access to a bathroom. The additional private guest suite on the main floor has a queen bed. Guests who stay in the basement have private access to the bathroom.

The great room features a large leather sectional, wood burning stove and a fully equipped kitchen that overlooks unobstructed magnificent mountain views. Enjoy dining inside or outside on the deck. An outdoor grill is available for your use (propane provided). If you’re quiet, you might spot an animal or two, or three!

Want a break from the kids? No problem, send them down to the walk-out basement to the fully outfitted game room featuring a pool table, big screen tv, wet bar and collection of card and board games. Perhaps the crisp mountain air is calling for a fire in the outdoor fire pit. The cabin has roasters for you to roast your hot dogs and marshmallows! Please note that pets are not allowed.
 
This cabin has all the amenities available for a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Just bring your own food, belongings and personal care items including bath soap and shampoo as those are not supplied. The cabin also has a washer and dryer for your laundry needs.

Things to Do:

The cabin is 32 miles away from the Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park and 12 miles away from Blue Mesa Reservoir where you can enjoy recreational boating or fishing. The closest resorts are Crested Butte (1.5 hours West) and Telluride (2 hours East) where you can enjoy skiing in the Winter and a variety of activities in the Summer. 

In the SUMMER, enjoy great hiking, biking, off-roading, and fishing right as you walk out the front door. Hazel Lake is a short walk from the cabin where you can enjoy the beautiful views or fish for free without state licensure using our guest pass. Please note that swimming is restricted in this lake and others in the area. Enjoy free outdoor concerts at the Arrowhead Mountain Lodge 1.8 miles down the road every Saturday night in the Summer from Memorial Day Weekend to Labor Day Weekend. Don’t feel like cooking? Arrowhead Mountain Lodge has you covered at their in-house restaurant and bar. Check their hours of operation at all that they have to offer at Arrowhead Mountain Lodge. If you enjoy ATV-ing, the 1.5 hour off-road drive to Lake City may interest you where you can access Engineer Pass, Alpine Loop, and Cinnamon Pass. * Please note that you will need to trailer your off-road vehicles to access these trails. Off road vehicles are not permitted on roads in Colorado. There is a short section before Lake City where off road vehicles are not allowed. Arrowhead Mountain Adventures has off-road vehicles to rent. 

Do you like to hunt? The cabin during the FALL can’t be beat! It is in Unit 66 and on the border of Unit 65. There's plenty of hiking, biking, off-roading and fishing left to do during the months of September and October too.

In the WINTER, enjoy 32 miles of groomed trails on the Alpine Plateau courtesy of the Arrowhead Snowmobile Club. Search for Arrowhead Snowmobile for maps and more information abou

description_text:
At 9700 feet, surrounded by Gunnison National Forest sits this exquisite custom-built log cabin with three bedrooms, open kitchen, wood burning fireplace and large balcony.  Nature abounds on this private 40-acre estate with open meadows, hill-side aspens, and an abundance of wildlife.  This property borders national forest above gold medal fishing waters near Almont and Crested Butte, perfect for all outdoor enthusiasts.  Enjoy sunny days, star-studded nights, and peace from the city.

 The space 
Tenderheart Cabin is an impressive structure built with 24 foot log poles.  The property also has a large garage and barn with electricity and water if you want to bring your horses.  There are currently no barn animals staying there.  The cabin is completely off-grid, electricity comes from an extensive photovoltaic 24Volt battery bank system that easily provides all the power needed for modern indoor life  (a propane generator can provide electricity if there is an uncommon stretch of days with cloudy skies).  Clean, fresh tasting well water is free-flowing for the kitchen and bathrooms, and radiant floor heating comes from underground propane tanks.  The stove, fridge and freezer are also propane powered for efficient, everyday reliability.  Guests are welcome to use the large wood-burning Jotul fireplace to create a toasty cabin environment.  There is an abundance of split aspen firewood ready for all guests.  Cabin was just outfitted with Starlink internet service, so service is very fast and stable for work or entertainment.

There is a king bed in the master suite on the main floor.  The main bathroom has two access points from hallway and bedroom.  Upstairs you will find two large rooms with open ceilings and a large space for entertaining.  There is a queen bed in one room and bunk bed and full size bed in the other room.  The area is open, so do not expect a closed door bedrooms on this second level.

The basement is currently unfinished but has radiant heat floors, washer and dryer, utility sink, large freezer and toilet.  It's a clean space with walk-out access to outside.  This will be finished with a full-bathroom and bedroom next year.

On the outside deck there is a propane grill and just off the wraparound deck you will find a fire pit and benches for star-gazing.

 Other things to note 
Currently Verizon cellular service works from the property.  I usually have 2 bars of service on my phone.  This is currently the only internet service, but that should change by end of the year.

description_text:
4 bedroom, 6 bath, separate 1 bedroom apartment (this is the 4th bedroom)

 The space 
"Fairway to Heaven," a  gorgeous 4+ bedroom home on the golf course at The Club at Crested Butte, and just minutes to the town of Crested Butte by car or bike.  It offers absolute luxury from the moment you walk in.  The house has been decorated with gorgeous decor throughout and accented with natural wood and stone. 

Upon entering the home, you will find yourself in a phenomenal great room complete with upscale living, dining and kitchen spaces.  In the living area you can warm up next to the gas fireplace after a long day on the slopes or curl up on the couch and watch your favorite show on the large smart tv.  The generously sized dining area seats 8 easily at the table and 3 more at the bar top.  Part of the great room experience is the fully equipped "chef's kitchen" where all you need to create a feast is available to you. Out the French doors from this room is an expansive and private deck with a dining table and chairs as well as a smaller deck with comfortable seating to enjoy the view of Mt. CB.  There is also a fantastic new hot tub on the deck for your use.

The house is set up with 2 primary suites, one on each floor.  The lower primary suite has a king bed and ensuite bathroom with a double vanity and tub/shower combo.  The upper primary suite has a king bed, smart TV and ensuite bathroom complete with a separate soaking tub and shower.

The 3rd bedroom is on the main floor of the house and has 2 full sized beds and an ensuite bathroom.  Also on this floor is a laundry room and powder bath.

Upstairs you will also find an open office that has 2 desks, a pullout couch (full size), gas fireplace and flat screen television.  Next to this is another full bathroom with a tub/shower combo.  The office is a great place to work from and to enjoy a little downtime.  All televisions have satellite tv.  

On the west side of the house there is a separate apartment accessible from an outside entrance.  Completely private with a living area, small kitchen, full bath and bedroom with a queen bed and a futon, this is a great space for anyone needing a bit of their own space.  

The 2 car garage has space to park one car  or store bikes as the owner does keep a car in the 2nd bay.  The driveway can accommodate 4 cars maximum.

The home is meticulously cared for and has beautiful gardens and a large private deck to enjoy on a summer day.  You can't find a finer property to enjoy your time here in Crested Butte!  

All of our kitchens are fully stocked with pots, pans, cookware and utensils.  While most properties have salt, pepper, and basic cooking pantry items, we do not guarantee these will be available upon arrival.

The minimum age for all persons in this property is 30 years, excepting children (of all ages) with their parent or legal guardian.
Please note that we do count all children and infants in the headcount for the property.
This property is not pet friendly. The HOA does not allow RV's or trailers to be parked in the driveway.  All vehicles must be parked in the driveway and not street-side.

We do NOT allow parties of any kind, this includes but is not limited to weddings, rehearsal dinners, bachelor or bachelorette parties/gatherings.  Only 10 people are allowed in/on the property at any given time.

Please note that our company does have a separate rental policy that will be emailed to you immediately after booking and this will need to be signed by you.  If you wish to see it prior to booking, just send us an email.

 Guest access 
Check-in instructions to include key codes will be sent to you 3 days prior to your arrival by email after 4 pm MST.

description_text:
Does this deck make my Butte look big? Yes! Relax in this beautifully situated mountain retreat after enjoying all your alpine activities. Built into the slope of the mountain, the living space and deck are on the second floor, elevated high off the green belt, giving unobstructed views of the Butte and surrounding hills, bursting with an ever changing symphony of color throughout the seasons. All this while the town and slopes are just 7 minutes away along a gorgeous drive in the foothills.

 The space 
When you first walk in the front door of our beautiful home, you will be drawn like a magnet straight out the back door to the huge deck, which towers 3 stories above the hill below and offers one of the best views of the Butte in the area. The summer brings a progressive kaleidoscope of wildflowers to the slope surrounding the house, with a different mix each week. In the fall, the aspens lining the walls of the valley glow a brilliant gold. Sunsets and sunrises are especially amazing, as the light slowdances over the Butte and sky, lighting up the clouds behind the mountain in pinks, oranges and purples. While you’re loving the view, you’ll take a moment to appreciate how quiet is is up here, and what a special retreat from your busy life this really is. Spend as much time out there as you like but eventually come back inside to see how awesome the rest of the house is. 

The living space is a wide-open floor plan with vaulted cedar ceilings for big gatherings of family and friends. The very well-equipped kitchen with subzero fridge and high-end appliances will help you create delicious meals with your crew. Gather around the rustic dining table or take your food and a glass of wine back outside to the iron outdoor dining set. Comfortable leather seating around a large, beautiful stone hearth and wood-burning fireplace will keep you toasty on cold nights. Touches of luxury mountain decor make the space magical, and all of it is graced with floor to ceiling windows to bring the same breathtaking view inside.

The large master Wildflower Suite is on the same floor and has its own access to the deck. In the morning, let the sun slowly fill the room as it grazes over the butte, or draw the shades and sleep late in the comfortable king bed. After a long day skiing, fishing, biking or hiking, you’ll love to relax alone or with your partner in the huge jacuzzi tub or steam shower.

Downstairs, you’ll find three more themed bedrooms. The River Room has a large rustic king size bed and corner seating area with views to the surrounding slopes of flowers and blue spruce trees.  

The large Moose Room is designed for families or kids, with one queen and two twin log beds, and a peaceful and secluded view to the back porch and aspen trees. 

Finally, the Bear Room is decorated with kids in mind, and has two low twin beds.

These rooms share a large downstairs bathroom.  There is also a full laundry room and another living space/media room, with access to another secluded lower back porch shaded and hidden by whispering aspens. 

If you continue down from the lower deck, the covered flagstone patio has a new hot tub and additional seating area with the same amazing views of the butte. 

Meridian Lake Park is, in our opinion, the prime location in Crested Butte, being the perfect balance of a quiet retreat and unparalleled view of mountain living, all with the ski resort and downtown less than 8 minutes away along a gorgeous curvy drive through the foothills. 

As amazing as the house and view is, you come to CB to get outside for peace and adventure. The Meridian reservoir can be seen from the house and it stocked with fish, if you’re into that. Or take a short hike up the hill past the reservoir to the natural alpine Long Lake for swimming in the summer. In the winter, kids can sled down the hill the house is on.

description_text:
Welcome to Trailhead XL at Crested Butte (TH@CB)!

This 5 bedroom, 3.5 bath custom home nestled in an aspen grove offers spectacular views of Mt. Crested Butte and the Elk Range.

Just 8 minutes to both the ski area and the historic district in Crested Butte, the best part of the home is the multiple trailheads right out the door. 

With a fully equipped kitchen, open concept, hot tub, Peloton, and mountain modern amenities, this special home is your base camp for your next Colorado adventure.

 The space 
For indoor pursuits, the gourmet kitchen awaits your culinary creations and the island and dining table have plenty of seating for everyone to gather and admire the panoramic views. 

Watch the fiery alpenglow on the surrounding peaks as you grill on the deck,  linger on the flagstone patio directly off the kitchen, and soak in the hot tub (patio furniture is only available during the snow free months).

Relax at the end of the day with the remote controlled gas fireplace and 4K smart TV with Chromecast/Netflix/YoutubeTV. The home has solid wifi (25 up/25 down) throughout if you need to stay connected, but we hope you find time to unplug!  

When it’s time to sleep, the spacious upstairs master suite features a king bed and private spa retreat with a jacuzzi tub and walk-in steam shower.

Also upstairs is a queen bedroom sharing a Jack and Jill bathroom with another large bedroom featuring two double beds. 

Downstairs you’ll find a second queen bedroom with en suite bath and workspace. The last bedroom has a double bed. As a bonus, the lower area has a full kitchen, Peloton bike, and lounge area of its own.

description_text:
Cozy Mountain Retreat with Stunning Views | Near Crystal Mill & Hot Springs

Peaceful, light-filled mountain cabin with stunning views above Marble, Colorado. Pet- and family-friendly with vaulted ceilings, wood fireplace, Starlink WiFi, and a wrap-around deck for stargazing or morning coffee. Right near - Crystal Mill,  hot springs, hiking, fly fishing, and backcountry skiing stargazing. A cozy, scenic retreat perfect for adventure, relaxation, or a romantic mountain getaway.

 The space 
Main Living Space
Enjoy six large windows (some over 12 feet high!) with sweeping views of Marble. The open-plan layout includes a full kitchen, TV, and a cozy central wood-burning fireplace — perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring.

Bedrooms

Primary Bedroom: King bed with walk-in wardrobe, ensuite bathroom, and direct access to the deck.

Bedroom 2 (Upstairs & Secluded): Queen bed, ensuite, and a dedicated workstation with a view.

Bedroom 3: Twin bed plus a floor trundle. A half bathroom is located just next door in the hallway.

An air mattress and bedding for 2 are also available.

Deck & Extras
The spacious wrap-around deck can be accessed from both the main space and primary bedroom — ideal for morning coffee or stargazing. Full laundry and pantry located next to the kitchen. There’s also a welcoming landing area at the front entrance for gear or boots.

Connectivity

Landline phone available at all times.

Cell service works via WiFi calling (Starlink).

Internet: Starlink has been excellent — fast, reliable, and supports multiple devices, streaming, and WiFi calls.

If you ever have issues with the connection, check the Starlink satellite dish above the sliding door. Snow build-up can occasionally block the signal. A broom should be nearby for a quick sweep if needed.

 Guest access 
Getting There

Nearest Airports:
• Aspen/Pitkin County Airport (ASE) – 54 miles
• Eagle County Regional Airport (EGE) – 68 miles

Important for Winter Stays (Nov–April):
To access the property safely in winter months, an AWD or 4WD vehicle with all-weather or snow tires is required. The road to the cabin is unpaved and winds up the hill with four bends (just over a mile), but it is plowed regularly after snowstorms.

 Other things to note 
Water Use
The cabin operates on a localized well system. While there’s plenty of fresh mountain water available, it’s not an endless city supply — the system has a daily capacity. Following the simple water guidelines provided in the guest manual (and at the property) will ensure you have more than enough for a comfortable stay.

Groceries & Dining
The nearest large chain grocery store is about a 35-minute drive away. There’s a small general store in Redstone (20 minutes) for basics, but hours can be unpredictable. We recommend bringing food and supplies with you, especially if you plan to cook at the cabin.

Dining options in and around Marble are limited and can vary by season or day — if you're planning to eat out, it’s best to call ahead to confirm hours and availability.

description_text:
Escape to Wild Pine Cabin, your riverside retreat in CO’s scenic North Fork valley. Tucked in 30 acres of pine forests, this private cabin combines rustic charm with thoughtful comforts: a wood-burning fireplace, a hot tub, cozy interiors, and space to unwind.

Experience intentional rest and healing, whether it’s morning coffee beside the river, guided yoga or massage, horseback trails, or hiking to wildflowers. Perfect for couples, wellness seekers, and nature lovers craving a soulful escape.

 The space 
- Riverside retreat with panoramic mountain and river views

- Thoughtfully styled cabin interior with wood accents and cozy lighting

- Private outdoor hot tub – perfect for starlit soaks

-Full Spa menu available: Optional on-site massage, yoga, Acupuncture, Reiki, sound therapy, Ayurvedic meals, and much more.

- River fishing, river walks, and wildlife watching

Tucked into the mountains between the North Fork Valley and McClure Pass, the Wild Pine Cabin is a cozy, private escape made for slowing down and settling into the season.

From November through spring, the horses and farm animals spend their days at their winter pasture, leaving the cabin and surrounding property especially quiet and private. There are no animals on the property during the winter months, giving you the space entirely to yourself.

The cabin is warmly dressed for fall and winter, with cozy touches throughout, a wood-burning fireplace, hot tub, mountain views, and everything you need for a peaceful mountain stay.

Step outside and you are surrounded by winter adventure. Snowshoe right from the cabin, explore nearby trails, watch for wildlife, or head out for skiing and mountain towns. Kebler Pass is just minutes away, while Crested Butte, Carbondale, Aspen, Marble, Redstone, and Glenwood Springs are all within reach.

Or don't go anywhere at all.

Make coffee slowly. Build a fire. Soak under the stars. Curl up with a book. Let the snow fall.

The Wild Pine Cabin is a place to disappear for a little while and remember how good it feels to have nowhere else to be.

Winter stays are available beginning November 17.

 Guest access 
Guests have full access to the entire property during their stay. Wander along the river, soak in the hot tubs, dip into the cold plunge pools, or relax by the fire pit under the stars.

description_text:
The one of a kind, historic, "Almont Adobe House!"  Located riverfront with private fishing and National Forest access, only 15 minutes to Gunnison and 25 minutes to Crested Butte.

 The space 
Updates to the home have allowed for all the modern amenities while preserving the home's Native American authenticity. This special property offers close proximity to endless outdoor activities (skiing, biking, boating, hiking, off road ...
The space
...trails, etc.). Among the most popular, world class fishing and whitewater rafting only a few steps off your private deck.

Over a 100 years ago the homesteading family had many options in the Gunnison Valley. It's no wonder they chose this area early on, considered by many locals to be one of the best properties in the county. The Adobe House was originally built in the 1920s as a fishing camp and artist getaway. Tucked away on an acre at the end of a private road surrounded by National Forest, it's a unique natural reserve type setting. This provides your own secluded world of outdoor enjoyment. The bordering National Forest land gives exclusive easy access to over a mile of additional fishable river and countless miles of hiking not easily accessible to the public. As part of the Almont Triangle big game range, you'll see wildlife in the area such as big horn sheep, elk, deer, bald eagles, and much more. You'll quickly find this location and access to these amenities are unique to the property giving you a mountain getaway that will take you back a century in time.

Today, it's a short walk to Three Rivers Resort and The Almont Resort offering two restaurants with bars and great food. They also provide services such as fly fishing supplies, white water rafting, various outfitting and guided tours, as well as a small store providing popular provisions. A free bus in front of the Almont Resort will take you to Gunnison and Crested Butte which are both about ~15 minutes away (downloadable app to track bus location available). Enjoy all the restaurants, shopping, and recreation that both Crested Butte and Gunnison have to offer. Pay less to play there while retreating back to your peaceful and private land and bungalow on the river.

This home has 3 bedrooms and one and a half bathrooms. The first two bedrooms (2) having King beds and the third room has a (1) Bunk bed that is a double on the bottom and twin bed on top! The third bedroom is currently waiting for the installation of a sliding barn door, so right now it only has a sheet for privacy from the living room. This homeowner has also recently upgraded his internet service to 60MB.

description_text:
Gorgeous home on 35 acres just 2 miles to town.  Hot tub, game room!

 The space 
Nestled on 55 acres of alpine wilderness just 2 miles from downtown Crested Butte, this newly renovated luxury home sits on the flank of Red Lady peak, surrounded by mountain meadows, old-growth pine and aspen forests, and sweeping views of the Elk Mountains. A footbridge leads to a private alpine meadow perfect for flower gazing, wildlife viewing, hiking, snowshoeing, or sledding, with further access to Red Lady's flanks and the famed views of Kebler Pass. The home sleeps up to 10 (adults, kids, and infants included) and features vaulted ceilings, an open floor plan, a heated two-car garage, a hot tub, a game room, 3 fireplaces, and Starlink satellite Wi-Fi capable of handling dozens of devices.

One flight up from the entrance, the main floor centers on an open living, dining, and kitchen area: a spacious, newly remodeled kitchen with an island seating 8-10 and a casual table, a cozy fireplace seating area with deck access, a formal dining table for 10, and a vaulted living room with a gas fireplace and seating for 10. French doors lead to a second-story deck with a gas grill, table and chairs, and private views of Whetstone and Axtell peaks, with total seclusion from other homes. The master suite is also on this floor, with a king bed, work desk, walk-in closet, and a remodeled ensuite bath with double vanities, a soaking tub, and an oversized shower. A cozy enclosed loft above the kitchen holds a third bedroom with 3 twin beds, a smart TV, and armoire, near a powder room.

Downstairs, the rec room offers a large smart TV, sound system, electronic dart board, wet bar, ping pong, foosball, a PacMan arcade table, board games, a gas fireplace, an inviting couch, oversized recliners, two daybeds, and a full bathroom. The ground/entrance level holds two additional guest rooms—one queen, one king with smart TV—sharing a bathroom, each with a closet and drawers.

The climate-controlled two-car garage includes cubbies for boots and helmets, hooks for outerwear, ski pole bins, a ski rack, a heated drying rack, ample charging outlets, and an extra full-size fridge, plus access to the hot tub. The hot tub sits sheltered under the back porch, seats 7, and has massaging jets with an easy-to-operate lid. Additional parking is available in the driveway and near the barn (the barn itself is locked and not accessible to guests), along with an adjustable basketball hoop and outdoor gear like frisbees, sleds, and balls.

Just 2 miles (5 minutes by car or bike) from downtown Crested Butte, a National Historic District known as "the last great American ski town" in winter and "the wildflower capital of Colorado" in summer, guests have easy access to Crested Butte Mountain Resort (on the Epic Pass), guided backcountry adventures, golf at the Crested Butte Country Club, white water rafting, fly fishing on the Slate, East, Taylor, and Gunnison rivers, horseback riding, hiking, biking, camping, rock climbing, paragliding, and year-round community events at the CB Center for the Arts and historic Majestic Theatre.

Please note: the road to the property, though stunning, is winding with 600 feet of elevation gain from town; a 4WD/AWD vehicle is required in winter, though the road and driveway are professionally maintained and plowed. No smoking is permitted anywhere on the property, and no trailers are allowed. Renters must be 30 or older, though children of all ages are welcome with a parent or guardian; total occupancy (including children and infants) is capped at 10 to protect the well and septic system.

Nestled in the desirable Meridian Lake Park neighborhood, Salt Fork Lodge is a cozy 4BR/3BA home with stunning mountain views and a stylish western interior.  Snuggle up near the gas fireplace, cook dinner in the well-equipped full kitchen, or enjoy the stars in the 8 person hot tub with views of Crested Butte Mountain and Mt Whetstone. With a large bunk room and areas to relax, Salt Fork Lodge is a perfect family getaway. One well behaved dog may be allowed by request, with a $250 pet fee.

 The space 
Salt Fork Lodge is nested into the mountains, with 360 degree views of the spectacular peaks around Crested Butte. The neighborhood backs to the National Forest, giving easy access to hiking, mountain biking and swimming in the high alpine Long Lake. The Crested Butte ski area is a short 8 minute drive, and we're only 4 miles from charming downtown Crested Butte with shops and restaurants.  Guests have access to the entire property, including the insulated 2 car garage with ski rack and places to store your gear. The open flow and outdoor spaces make this home a great choice for families and groups of friends looking to enjoy Crested Butte. 

Each of the 4 bedrooms has large windows with views. There are two bedrooms with queen beds, one with a king bed and one bunk room that has two full-over-full bunks (a total of 4 full beds in that room). The bunk room has an ensuite full bath as well as a Smart TV and chairs for kids to enjoy a movie in their own space. 

 There is another full bath in between the two queen bedrooms upstairs, and the third full bath is on the main level near the King room. This bathroom has a walk-in shower, making it a good option for anyone who prefers not to use the stairs. 

The main level has a living room with large leather sectional sofa + smart TV for Netflix, etc. The living room is connected to the open kitchen which includes a breakfast bar, dining table for 8 and two leather recliners near the gas fireplace, making it a perfect place to cozy up for morning coffee. This room opens onto the covered porch and large back deck and hot tub area.

In the warm months, there is an outdoor fire table as well as BBQ grill.

 Guest access

description_text:
Serene mountain home in Crested Butte South with the best views in the Valley. Peaceful, quiet location nestled in a mature Aspen grove with expansive  views to the west and south. Perfect for families; the house sits on a dead end road above the busier grid of CB South. Open floor plan with wrap-around windows and large bar in the kitchen for cooking and entertaining. Cozy in winter and shaded and breezy in the summer. A true mountain retreat!

 The space 
Please note: The house is set up to accommodate no more than  4 adults and 4 kids not 8 adults as the 3rd bedroom is a bunk room.  We will accept 6 adults provided you understand that two guests will be sleeping on bottom bunks. 

This is our part-time home, not just a rental property and we love sharing the beautiful views and tranquil spot with friends and guests alike. The home was built in 2007 and has an open floor plan with kitchen, dining and living room in one large space, surrounded by windows with views of the valley. There are two queen bedrooms, one with a private attached bath, and also a bunk room for the kids. There is natural light throughout with window coverings in the bedrooms only. 

Engineered wood floors throughout give it a cozy, rustic feel. The yard is a lovely natural setting within a grove of Aspens. The front deck is perfect for spending an afternoon hanging out with friends or enjoying a book while the Aspens quake in the breeze.  This area of Crested Butte South (CB South as it is called) on the slope above the grid has less traffic/noise and feels incredibly relaxing and serene. There are a handful of other homes on our street, which is a dead end road, and its a perfect spot for a morning walk enjoying your coffee in the sunshine. Store your mountain bikes or skis in our large barn-like garage. 

The house has all the necessary modern amenities but with a rustic, 'mountain chic' feel appropriate for the location. If you are looking for a luxury rental, this is not your place and we say that only because we want our guests to enjoy their visit as much as possible. CB South has more of a laid back, locals vibe and is approximately 6 miles from the bustle of town and the ski resort, which is what many here prefer. 

CB South is a small community/residential subdivision 10-12 minutes from the town of Crested Butte and about 15 minutes from Mt. Crested Butte (though it is really all just one large valley with various subdivisions and CB South is the first one as you come up HWY 135 from Gunnison/Almont).  The access point for the area is Cement Creek Road, which offers an incredible network of mountain biking and hiking trails, fishing and camping.  The house is also around 20 minutes from Almont, at the confluence of the Taylor and East rivers, and a popular place to  put in for a fish or raft trip down the Gunnison.  Gunnison is around 25-30 minutes and offers more stores, restaurants and access to the western side of the area including Blue Mesa reservoir and Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park.

 Guest access 
The entire house and garage is accessible to guests except for the loft which is our home office.

 Other things to note 
Although there are light curtains in the bedrooms there are not black out shades. There is extensive natural light throughout the house.

description_text:
Escape to our serene cabin retreat nestled in the heart of nature in the Arrowhead community. This getaway offers a perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort, providing an unforgettable experience for nature enthusiasts or families seeking quality time together.

The cabin features an inviting open-plan living area with wooden accents and large windows offering breathtaking forest views. Relax on the deck, enjoy meals in the fully equipped kitchen, and unwind in the cozy bedrooms.

 Guest access 
The cabin is within Arrowhead, a mountain home community located between Gunnison and Montrose, south of Highway 50 on the Alpine Plateau Road. From May into November the cabin is accessible by car. 

When there is adequate snow, usually in November, the roads within Arrowhead are closed to car and truck traffic. During winter, when the internal roads are closed, you need to park at the winter parking lot and traverse the remaining mile to the cabin by snowmobile, snowshoe, or skis. Snowmobiles can be rented from Arrowhead Mountain Adventures located next to the Arrowhead Mountain Inn.

 Other things to note

*Dogs ARE NOT allowed at any time during your stay. Violation of this rule will result in an automatic $300 fine.

*The nearest store (of any kind) is 30+ miles away through mountain terrain. Shop for food or other needed supplies BEFORE you arrive. There is a large pantry and fridge for you to store all your food and supplies. If you do find yourself in a pinch, Arrowhead Mountain Lodge has a very limited list of things available: milk, soda, bread, and cheese. 

*Be aware that this cabin is in a remote location and the main road to get there (Alpine Plateau Road off Hwy 50) is an uphill dirt road. Big on views, coziness, and tranquility... that’s Slate River Retreat. Outside, there’s no shortage of recreational options, ranging from mild to wild!  The space 
For summer visitors, there is a plethora of activities! In this area, hiking, mountain biking, and wildflowers dominate the landscape and nowhere else in Colorado can match it, but there’s so much more!  The fairways of the Robert Trent Jones designed golf course at the Club at Crested Butte is just 3 wood away.  White water rafting on the Taylor River is less than 30 minutes away, and the valley also offers great fly fishing opportunities on three different rivers.  Rent a paddleboard and float the Slate, or take one up to nearby Lake Irwin.   Looking to simply stretch your legs and take in the fresh mountain air and non-stop, breath-taking vistas? Winter time is equally amazing.  The ski resort at Mt. Other winter activities include snow shoeing and cross country skiing, both available through the world-class Nordic Center in town, and next to door to the that is an ice-skating arena!  Snowmobile guides and rentals are also very popular around Crested Butte.  Or just sit back in the warmth of Slate River Retreat and take in the peaceful, white landscape from the large windows found throughout the unit. 

Slate River Retreat is a quick 5-minute drive to historic downtown Crested Butte.  You can also take a 5 minute walk from the unit to the free RTA bus on Hwy 135 that will get you to the town of Crested Butte or the ski area.

The relaxing and peaceful atmosphere of this neighborhood, the comfort and coziness of the interior, and the amazing views....Slate River Retreat will make your trip to the mountains the perfect getaway!

Our home is located in the beautiful and highly-desired residential neighborhood of Meridian Lake Park that sits nestled in aspen forests along the side of Washington Gulch Valley.

Conveniently located 8 minutes from the Crested Butte Mountain Ski Resort parking lot and 10 minutes from downtown Crested Butte, our house offers a fantastic combination of peaceful isolation and ease of access to the surrounding area.

The neighborhood enjoys direct access to Snodgrass Mountain trail, one of the most popular hiking & mountain biking routes in the area. 

BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS

Master bedroom includes a king bed, private patio and massive walk-in closet. The connected oversized master bathroom comes equipped with heated marble floors, his & her sinks, walk-in shower / steam room and a jacuzzi tub.

Two bedrooms located upstairs – one with two queen beds and the other with one king bed. Both rooms include day beds perfect for lounging next to the oversized windows and each have their own private bathroom with walk-in shower.

The fourth bedroom is located above the garage and has one queen bed & one full bed and a full bathroom. This room is perfect as a kid’s “bunk room” and includes a TV with Roku. 

LIVING AREAS

Modern kitchen includes stainless steel appliances and is fully stocked with all the cooking equipment you and your group will need. Countertop bar with four seats is perfect for breakfast.  

Large dining room offers seating for 10 comfortably.

Private office with desk and monitor at front of the house is available for working.

Large hallway with coat racks and cubby holes can be used for storing / drying ski clothes.

Guests will find various outdoor equipment in the garage including skis, sleds, bikes and snowshoes that are available for use as long as they are left in the same condition in which they are found.   

OUTDOOR SPACE

Main back patio comes equipped with a basic charcoal grill, patio furniture and outdoor firepit. Note that during the winter, much of the back patio will be covered by snow and unavailable.
